reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.
reason.zh: 沿用的储备物业，本轮未重新打开原始来源核查。场地、电力、报价、需求和合同关键证据仍缺，不进入任一正式榜单。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Nevada commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Nevada州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: APD3 says it is the Pahranagat Valley retail district; Lincoln County Power District No.1 supplies its power.
claim.zh: APD3说明自己是PahranagatValley零售供电区，LincolnCountyPowerDistrictNo.1供应电力。

limitation.en: Upstream supplier is not retail account provider; exact meter unverified.
limitation.zh: 上游供应方非零售账户供电方，具体电表未核实。

claim.en: Large Commercial charges include fixed, energy and demand, with resale restriction; a separate variable PPAR applies to all customers’ kWh.
claim.zh: 大型商业包含固定、电量及需量费并有限制转售条款；全部客户另按电量收取可变PPAR。

limitation.en: EV charging interpretation requires utility confirmation, not automatic prohibition. PPAR value/demand interval/eligibility unknown.
limitation.zh: 充电适用解释需供电公司确认，不能自动认定禁止；PPAR值、需量间隔及资格未知。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger lease/easements, signatory authority, exclusivity and 24-hour public-access rights remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电租约、地役权、签署权限、排他条款及24小时公众通行权未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No parcel-specific firm capacity, connection scope/date or utility construction quote was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得地块级确定容量、接入范围/日期或供电施工报价。

remainingCritical.en: Final engineering, permit clearance, complete EPC cost and lifecycle operating terms remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 最终设计、许可、完整EPC造价及全生命周期运营条款未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No observed site charging revenue/utilization or defensible traffic-to-session conversion was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得场地实测充电收入/利用率或可验证车流转充电次数关系。

changesToPrior.en: Separated retail supplier and exposed EV-classification/PPAR gaps.
changesToPrior.zh: 区分零售供电与上游供应，并发现EV分类及PPAR缺口。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Headline energy rate is not an achievable all-in EV price; no economic upgrade before classification and adders resolve.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 标示电量价非可实际取得的充电总价，分类及附加费解决前不提升经济性。

attempts.result: Signed primary schedule and full onboarding read; current PPAR value absent.
No EV resale interpretation presumed.

summary.en: No address-matched paid session or delivered-kWh time series found in this bounded search. Retail/store activity is not charging demand.
summary.zh: 本轮限定检索未找到同址付费次数或交付电量时序；零售活动不等于充电需求。

neededDocument.en: 12 months of timestamped paid sessions, delivered kWh, net realized price/refunds, uptime and outages; for a greenfield site, matched analogue logs plus a documented capture model.
neededDocument.zh: 连续12个月带时间戳的付费次数、交付电量、扣除退款后的实收价格、可用率及停机记录；新建场地需匹配类比站交易记录及有依据的获客模型。

provider.en: Alamo Sinclair / charging operator, if any
provider.zh: 获取对象：Alamo Sinclair／充电运营商（如有）

route.en: Owner-authorized anonymized CPMS export, monthly settlement reports and utility-bill reconciliation; no outreach performed.
route.zh: 取得业主授权的匿名充电管理系统导出、月度结算报告并与电费账单核对；本轮未对外联系。

notObtainedReason.en: No representative site-paid-session, kWh and realized-payment dataset was published in the opened sources. Posted rates, station status and aggregate traffic cannot establish realized orders; no operator data release was obtained.
notObtainedReason.zh: 已读来源未公开有代表性的本址付费订单、电量及实收数据。标价、站点状态和总体车流不能证明实际订单；未取得运营商数据披露。

summary.en: Prior published tariff or cost-allocation material is reusable, but no site-scoped turnkey EV construction quote and complete lifecycle operating budget was found.
summary.zh: 可复用既有公开费率或成本分配资料，但未取得场地专属充电总包报价及完整运营预算。

neededDocument.en: Scoped equipment/EPC/civil/transformer/interconnection/engineering/permit/contingency quote; rent, insurance, software, payment fees, maintenance, replacement and taxes; exclusions and validity.
neededDocument.zh: 含设备、EPC、土建、变压器、接电、设计、许可及预备费的范围明确报价；另列租金、保险、软件、支付费、运维、更新和税费、除外项及有效期。

provider.en: Alamo Sinclair / selected EV EPC / utility
provider.zh: 获取对象：Alamo Sinclair／选定充电EPC／供电方

route.en: Provide surveyed layout, load profile and landlord terms to EPC and utility, reconcile a common scope and all exclusions. A grant cap is not a full cost quote.
route.zh: 向EPC及供电方提供实测布局、负荷及业主条款，以同一范围核对全部除外项；补助上限不等于完整造价。

notObtainedReason.en: Opened awards, program budgets or generic estimates did not contain a complete, current, scoped parcel capital and operating budget. No owner/EPC executed quote was obtained.
notObtainedReason.zh: 已读获奖公告、项目规划预算或通用估算没有当前明确范围的本址完整资本与运营预算，未取得业主/EPC 已执行报价。

summary.en: Utility identity, class or regional infrastructure provides a contact route; no parcel-specific firm spare capacity, connection quote or energization date was found.
summary.zh: 供电主体、类别或区域设施可定位调查对象；未找到地块确定剩余容量、接电报价或送电日期。

neededDocument.en: Written load-service feasibility for exact meter/parcel and peak kW/kVA, voltage, upgrade scope/CIAC, tariff/riders, engineering and transformer lead time, firm energization conditions.
neededDocument.zh: 针对准确电表/地块及峰值kW/kVA的书面供电可行性，含电压、升级范围及用户出资、费率/附加费、工程/变压器周期及确定送电条件。

provider.en: Alamo Power District No. 3, retail service; Lincoln County Power upstream
provider.zh: 获取对象：Alamo Power District No. 3, 零售供电，上游为Lincoln County Power

route.en: Owner-authorized new/expanded-load service inquiry with site plan, interval load, peak import and phasing; engineering study if required. No application submitted.
route.zh: 取得业主授权后，以场地图、分时负荷、进口峰值及分期计划发起新增/扩容供电查询，必要时进行工程研究；本轮未提交申请。

notObtainedReason.en: Public utility information did not provide a parcel load-approval letter, binding connection price and committed delivery date. A tariff or nearby substation is not spare capacity.
notObtainedReason.zh: 公共电力资料未提供本址负荷批准函、约束性接电价格及承诺交期。费率或附近变电站不等于剩余容量。

priorityReason.en: Lower immediate public-data yield: public context exists, but no charging transaction logs or project cost/service study surfaced.
priorityReason.zh: 近期公开数据获取价值较低：已有背景资料，但未见充电交易、项目造价或供电研究。

attempts.result: Bounded search performed; no complete site-demand, turnkey-cost or firm-capacity dataset obtained.
Bounded search performed; no complete site-demand, turnkey-cost or firm-capacity dataset obtained.
Bounded search performed; no complete site-demand, turnkey-cost or firm-capacity dataset obtained.

selectionReason.en: Lower immediate public-data yield: public context exists, but no charging transaction logs or project cost/service study surfaced.
selectionReason.zh: 近期公开数据获取价值较低：已有背景资料，但未见充电交易、项目造价或供电研究。

decisionChange.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
decisionChange.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

Connection, construction or property costs fail the investment policy.

Owner/tenant consent, parking rights, lease term and exclusivity
Round-the-clock charging/restrooms, accessibility and entrances

Local permits, drainage/flood exposure and physical layout

业主/租户许可、停车位、租期及排他合作
全天充电与卫生间开放、无障碍及出入口

provider.zh: NHDES大众和解资金项目；ReVision Energy / EV Connect。

route.en: Request retained quarterly files under grant item 170 / NH-VW-2021-01, with the exact address; ask for anonymized records and separate any withheld fields. No request sent.
route.zh: 按资助条目170 / NH-VW-2021-01及准确地址索取已留存季度文件，要求匿名化并单列不予披露字段；尚未发送。

requestContent.en: Latest 12 months of session ID/timestamps, kWh, transaction fee/refunds, uptime, outages; monthly settlement totals and utility reconciliation.
requestContent.zh: 最近12个月订单编号/时间戳、电量、交易费/退款、可用率、停机；月度结算与电费核对。

acceptanceCriteria.en: Time period and device identifiers match; paid/free sessions separated; energy and cash reconcile.
acceptanceCriteria.zh: 期间与设备编号一致，付费/免费分开，电量及实收可核对。

reason.en: Grant scope and exclusions are available; invoices, noneligible costs and updated service/battery costs are absent.
reason.zh: 资助范围与排除项已补齐，实际发票、未资助成本、更新的服务/电池成本仍缺。

provider.en: NHDES retained reimbursement file; ReVision / host / equipment service provider.
provider.zh: NHDES报销档案；ReVision/场地主/设备服务商。

route.en: Ask for Exhibit C payment packet plus exclusions ledger and current repair versus expansion quotes.
route.zh: 索取附件C付款资料、未资助项目清单，以及维修与扩建分别报价。

requestContent.en: Final vendor invoices, change orders, paid reimbursements, utility/land/taxes, battery warranty and replacement, network and O&M.
requestContent.zh: 最终供应商发票、变更单、实付补贴、电力/土地/税、电池保修及更换、联网和运维。

acceptanceCriteria.en: Complete same-design lifecycle scope; no grant-as-total-cost substitution.
acceptanceCriteria.zh: 同一设计完整生命周期范围，不以资助额替代总成本。

reason.en: Public battery-input claim is not an engineering record or expansion commitment.
reason.zh: 公开电池取电说法不是工程资料或扩容承诺。

provider.en: ReVision and NHEC with host/account authority.
provider.zh: ReVision与NHEC，需地主/账户授权。

route.en: Retrieve as-built single-line and interval import first; request incremental-load design separately.
route.zh: 先取得竣工单线图与分时取电记录，再单独申请新增负荷设计。

requestContent.en: Actual grid input rating, usable battery kWh, cycling/availability, utility service agreement and any expansion cost/schedule.
requestContent.zh: 真实取电额定值、可用电池电量、循环/可用率、供电协议及扩容成本/排期。

acceptanceCriteria.en: Utility confirms specific design capacity, ownership boundary, price and dated schedule.
acceptanceCriteria.zh: 电力公司确认具体设计容量、产权边界、价格及带日期排期。

nextAction.en: Obtain the exact records listed above; match asset, period and design before changing financial inputs. No request has been sent.
nextAction.zh: 按上述范围取得具体记录，匹配设备、期间与设计后才能修改财务输入；尚未发送请求。

candidates.name: Indian Hill Trading Post
candidates.coordinateQuality: AFDC existing charger marker

thesis.network: Outdoor retail/fuel location at Moosehead Lake. Consider only if measured redundancy/capacity needs justify additional build.
thesis.investor: No verified project economics; excluded from the qualified investment list.

candidates.counterargument: Efficiency Maine marks this site COMPLETED; AFDC has two nearby records 405694 and416425 with 180kW units, apparently overlapping. Do not sum both or present a new gap.
killCriteria: Existing or imminent supply removes the supported incremental value.
Connection, construction or property costs fail the investment policy.
No enforceable site rights or compliant parking/access layout
Measured demand does not support the stated objective.
unknowns: Written utility capacity, connection cost and delivery schedule
Owner/tenant consent, parking rights, lease term and exclusivity
Round-the-clock charging/restrooms, accessibility and entrances
Actual charging demand, realized price and contractual fees
Local permits, drainage/flood exposure and physical layout

facts.claim: Owner describes outdoor/grocery services and 24-hour fuel island.
University confirms 148 Moosehead Lake Rd.
Phase 7 Indian Hill Trading Post is marked COMPLETED.

rankRationale.network: Historical research order only. Outdoor retail/fuel location at Moosehead Lake. Consider only if measured redundancy/capacity needs justify additional build.
rankRationale.investor: Requires the same evidence and payback gates as every other property.

thesis.network: Moosehead Lake户外零售/加油物业；仅在实测冗余或容量需求成立后考虑增建。
thesis.investor: 未形成足够投资证据，不进入正式投资名单。

zh.counterargument: Efficiency Maine标记本址项目完成；AFDC两个180kW记录可能重叠，不能简单相加或声称空白。
unknowns: 电力公司书面接网容量、费用和交期
业主/租户许可、停车位、租期及排他合作
全天充电与卫生间开放、无障碍及出入口
实际充电需求、成交电价和合同费用
地方许可、排水/洪涝及现场布置
killCriteria: 现有或即将上线供给消除了可解释的增量价值
接网、施工或场地费用超出可接受条件
无法取得场地使用权或合规的停车/出入口布局
实测需求不能支持该视角的推进目标
zh.coordinateQuality: AFDC既有充电设备标记

rankRationale.network: 历史候选，仍须通过统一证据和回本门槛；尚未取得正式入选资格。
rankRationale.investor: 须通过统一证据与回本门槛。

zh.type: 已有充电物业 / 升级候选

facts.claim: 业主介绍户外用品、杂货及24小时加油岛。
缅因大学目录确认148 Moosehead Lake Rd。
Efficiency Maine 第7阶段 Indian Hill Trading Post 项目标记为完成。

reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.
reason.zh: 沿用的储备物业，本轮未重新打开原始来源核查。场地、电力、报价、需求和合同关键证据仍缺，不进入任一正式榜单。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Maine commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Maine州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: The 2025 real-estate book lists Four Seasons Trading Post,148 Moosehead Lake Road, parcel 0004-0030-A,3 acres, account 82.
claim.zh: 2025不动产税册列FourSeasonsTradingPost、148MooseheadLakeRoad、地块0004-0030-A、3英亩、账户82。

limitation.en: Book dateNov 22,2024; not current title or charger rights. Neighboring parcels not counted as available.
limitation.zh: 册页日期2024年11月22日，不是当前产权或充电权利，邻地不算可用。

claim.en: The 2026 personal-property book lists Indian Hill Supermarket and Trading Post at the same 148 Moosehead Lake Road.
claim.zh: 2026动产税册将IndianHillSupermarket及TradingPost列于同址148MooseheadLakeRoad。

limitation.en: Business/address corroboration, not real-estate or charger ownership; record datedSep 15,2025.
limitation.zh: 经营主体/地址旁证，不是不动产或充电设备产权，记录日期2025年9月15日。

claim.en: Owner’s charger page links EVConnect but uses generic Level 1/2 text, providing no dependable DC inventory.
claim.zh: 经营者充电页链接EVConnect，但使用一般Level1/2文字，无可靠直流设备清单。

limitation.en: Does not negate prior state completed-project evidence; current connectors/power/uptime require operator check.
limitation.zh: 不推翻此前州完工证据，当前接口、功率和可用率需运营商确认。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger lease/easements, signatory authority, exclusivity and 24-hour public-access rights remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电租约、地役权、签署权限、排他条款及24小时公众通行权未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No parcel-specific firm capacity, connection scope/date or utility construction quote was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得地块级确定容量、接入范围/日期或供电施工报价。

remainingCritical.en: Final engineering, permit clearance, complete EPC cost and lifecycle operating terms remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 最终设计、许可、完整EPC造价及全生命周期运营条款未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No observed site charging revenue/utilization or defensible traffic-to-session conversion was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得场地实测充电收入/利用率或可验证车流转充电次数关系。

changesToPrior.en: Added municipal property/acreage and identified equipment-description inconsistency.
changesToPrior.zh: 新增市政产权主体/面积，并发现设备描述不一致。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Ownership targeting improved; still existing-charging/co-location with no verified incremental economics or expansion rights.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 权属调查更明确，仍属既有充电/共址，增量经济性与扩建权未验证。

attempts.result: Both official books opened and exact address matched; assessments not land price.
MaineDOT utility-town PDF403; parcel provider not asserted.
Generic owner wording not used to erase prior completed DC supply.

summary.en: Specific contract telemetry route found; no observed paid-session/kWh export obtained.
summary.zh: 已定位具体合同运行数据路径，但尚未取得实测付费订单/电量导出。

neededDocument.en: Anonymized per-session kWh, timestamps, paid amount, failures, uptime and reporting period; seasonal coverage and competitor diversion evidence.
neededDocument.zh: 匿名逐单电量、时间戳、实付金额、失败与在线率及统计区间；季节覆盖和竞争站分流证据。

provider.en: Efficiency Maine Trust (records actually held), ReVision Energy / station network.
provider.zh: Efficiency Maine Trust（以其实际持有记录为准）、ReVision Energy/运营平台。

route.en: Request existing telemetry/reports for EM-011-2024, ReVision, 148 Moosehead Lake Road; the RFP says submissions are inspectable after award subject to exemptions. No outreach made.
route.zh: 按 EM-011-2024、ReVision、148 Moosehead Lake Road 精准索取既存运行报告；招标称中标后材料可按豁免规则查阅。本轮未发起联系。

notObtainedReason.en: No representative site-paid-session, kWh and realized-payment dataset was published in the opened sources. Posted rates, station status and aggregate traffic cannot establish realized orders; no operator data release was obtained.
notObtainedReason.zh: 已读来源未公开有代表性的本址付费订单、电量及实收数据。标价、站点状态和总体车流不能证明实际订单；未取得运营商数据披露。

summary.en: Cost form, reimbursement evidence requirements and excluded costs identified; actual site amounts remain missing.
summary.zh: 已确认成本表、报销凭证要求及排除费用；本址实际金额仍缺失。

neededDocument.en: Completed site cost proposal, award contract/amendments, reimbursement invoices, utility contributions, plus rent, O&M, insurance, replacements and incremental expansion quote.
neededDocument.zh: 已填本址成本表、获奖合同/修订、报销发票、电力分摊，加租金、运维、保险、更换与增量扩建报价。

provider.en: Efficiency Maine Trust; ReVision Energy; host and EPC/utility contractors.
provider.zh: Efficiency Maine Trust；ReVision Energy；场地主及 EPC/电力承包方。

route.en: Ask for the awarded EM-011-2024 cost form and paid-invoice file; reconcile excluded operating/land costs and obtain a separately scoped expansion quote.
route.zh: 索取 EM-011-2024 获奖成本表与付款发票档案；补齐被排除的运营/土地费用，再单独报价扩建方案。

notObtainedReason.en: Opened awards, program budgets or generic estimates did not contain a complete, current, scoped parcel capital and operating budget. No owner/EPC executed quote was obtained.
notObtainedReason.zh: 已读获奖公告、项目规划预算或通用估算没有当前明确范围的本址完整资本与运营预算，未取得业主/EPC 已执行报价。

summary.en: RFP identifies utility documents and metering rules, but no parcel capacity letter, connection quote or lead time was obtained.
summary.zh: 招标明确电力文件及计量要求，但未取得本址容量函、接电报价或交期。

neededDocument.en: As-built single-line and service rating, actual demand interval data, written incremental load capacity, utility work scope/quote/schedule.
neededDocument.zh: 竣工单线图和供电等级、实测需量曲线、增量负荷容量函、电力工程范围/报价/排期。

provider.en: ReVision Energy and serving utility, confirmed from actual account/service records.
provider.zh: ReVision Energy 与供电公司，须由真实账户/供电记录确认。

route.en: Retrieve utility-engagement documents filed with the awarded bid, then reconcile with as-built service and request an incremental load study.
route.zh: 先调取获奖投标附带的电力沟通文件，再核对竣工供电并申请增量负荷研究。

notObtainedReason.en: Public utility information did not provide a parcel load-approval letter, binding connection price and committed delivery date. A tariff or nearby substation is not spare capacity.
notObtainedReason.zh: 公共电力资料未提供本址负荷批准函、约束性接电价格及承诺交期。费率或附近变电站不等于剩余容量。

priorityReason.en: High data-acquisition value: completed exact-address grant project, named operator and posted price provide distinct routes to logs, as-built cost and electrical drawings.
priorityReason.zh: 获取价值高：同址补助项目已完成、有运营商及挂牌价，可分别追查交易、竣工成本和电气图。

claim.en: ChargeHub lists the exact 148 Moosehead Lake Road site with DC charging at $0.65/kWh plus a $1 flat fee and L2 at $0.38/kWh.
claim.zh: ChargeHub列同址148MooseheadLakeRoad直流价0.65美元/千瓦时加1美元固定费，交流价0.38美元/千瓦时。

limitation.en: Posted aggregator price is not realized net revenue or proof of sessions/day. CCS and NACS listings may represent connectors on shared dispensers and must not be added as independent stalls.
limitation.zh: 聚合挂牌价非实收净收入或每日订单证明；CCS与NACS可能同机接口，不可加总成独立车位。

claimScope.en: Named site or host only; does not establish capacity, sales or an investable new project.
claimScope.zh: 仅涉及具名场地或商户，不证明容量、销量或新项目可投资。

claim.en: Efficiency Maine’s April26,2024 notice names ReVision Energy at Indian Hill Trading Post,148 Moosehead Lake Road under EM-011-2024; its current project page marks it completed.
claim.zh: EfficiencyMaine2024年4月26日中标通知列ReVisionEnergy位于该址，编号EM-011-2024；当前项目页标已完成。

limitation.en: Award notice contains no site award amount, full cost or utilization; procurement/closeout file is the acquisition route.
limitation.zh: 通知无单站补助金额、完整造价或利用率；应获取采购及竣工文件。

claimScope.en: Named site or host only; does not establish capacity, sales or an investable new project.
claimScope.zh: 仅涉及具名场地或商户，不证明容量、销量或新项目可投资。

attempts.query: "Indian Hill" Greenville charging grant utilization cost
attempts.result: Bounded search performed; no complete site-demand, turnkey-cost or firm-capacity dataset obtained.
Bounded search performed; no complete site-demand, turnkey-cost or firm-capacity dataset obtained.
Original pages opened; postedprice/award/completion found, no sitevolume/fullcost/capacity.

selectionReason.en: High data-acquisition value: completed exact-address grant project, named operator and posted price provide distinct routes to logs, as-built cost and electrical drawings.
selectionReason.zh: 获取价值高：同址补助项目已完成、有运营商及挂牌价，可分别追查交易、竣工成本和电气图。

claim.en: The awarded RFP requires session times, kWh, power, customer charges and station-health data, with reports available to the Trust on request. This identifies a specific telemetry acquisition route.
claim.zh: 本项目所属招标要求记录每次充电时间、电量、功率、用户收费及设备状态，并按要求向 Trust 报告，因此已定位具体运行数据获取路径。

limitation.en: A reporting obligation is not evidence that a file was submitted, retained or disclosed; no session dataset was obtained.
limitation.zh: 报告义务不等于数据已提交、保存或公开；本轮未取得订单数据集。

claimScope.en: Awarded-program requirements; not proof of a submitted site dataset.
claimScope.zh: 获奖项目规则，不证明本址数据集已经提交。

claim.en: The RFP calls for per-site cost proposals and paid invoices for reimbursement. Real-estate rent/purchase and most operating expenses are outside eligible capital costs. The published workbook is an unfilled template.
claim.zh: 招标要求按场地提交成本方案，并用已付款发票申请报销；租地/购地与大部分运营费用不属于合格资本支出。已取得的公开工作簿是空白模板。

limitation.en: No completed site cost form, actual invoices, award amount or complete lifetime operating budget was found.

claim.en: EM-011-2024 Q&A describes up to 80% eligible capital support, net of expected tax credits and other grants, plus five-year demand-charge reimbursement capped at $100,000/site and limited to the awarded bid. Its indicative return-on-investment answer is 10–20 years.

limitation.en: Program-wide guidance, not Greenville’s awarded amount or audited return. The document does not define that ROI calculation. Existing 6/8-year hard gates remain unchanged; no incentive entered into this model.
limitation.zh: 这是项目通用说明，不是Greenville中标金额或经审计回收期，原文也未定义ROI计算口径；现有6/8年硬门槛不变，不把激励计入模型。

nextAction.en: Obtain the exact records listed above; match asset, period and design before changing financial inputs. No request has been sent.

facts.claim: 搜索摘要列明 Anderson’s Grocery 位于711 S Clark Ave；原文抓取失败，仅作历史线索。
此前搜索得到同名同址和营业时间，但未保存具体来源URL，不能作已完成核实的证据。

reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.
reason.zh: 沿用的储备物业，本轮未重新打开原始来源核查。场地、电力、报价、需求和合同关键证据仍缺，不进入任一正式榜单。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: Ferry PUD separates 50kW large power,500kW industrial and negotiated new loads above 1MW; new-service class follows engineering.
claim.zh: FerryPUD以50kW分大型用电、500kW分工业用电，新增超过1MW需协商，类别由工程确定。

limitation.en: Class thresholds are not available capacity; specific 400/500 prices inaccessible.

attemptedSources.result: Read relevant primary text this round

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Texas commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Texas州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official store detail page and read address/hours.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: Nearby existing DCFC creates an incremental-demand question.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: ARCO NE 119th Street, Vancouver, WA (id 323778), 0.215 straight-line miles, 4 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: Vancouver, WA - NE Hwy 99, CONSTRUCTION, 4.971 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 323778，直线 0.215 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 CONSTRUCTION。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

finding.en: Clark’s published commercial rates include demand-metering rules and require utility approval for energy resale. Parcel eligibility and applicable service class are not established.
finding.zh: Clark 正式费率包含需量计费和转售审批条件；本址类别/资格仍未知。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official current rates and read commercial demand / Schedule 34 applicability.
checks.nextEvidence: Utility confirmation of tariff, resale approval and complete interval-load bill model.
checks.significance: Do not model residential cents/kWh as the whole DCFC bill.

reason.en: Required land-control, utility, engineering quote and demand evidence remain missing; investment payback not proven.
reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

limitation.zh: 历史企业声明，不是当前产权或可用停车面积。

remainingCritical.zh: 已签业主/租户停车权、租金、独家限制及期限。

note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Texas commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Texas州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

title.en: Snohomish PUD standard Schedule 20
title.zh: Snohomish PUD常规20费率

limitation.en: April 1, 2026 standard Schedule 20, not promotional 20EV (expires 2030). Assumes uniform monthly energy, peaks 1200/500/300kW and connected load 1200kW in all scenarios; minimum daily bill reflects connected load. Excludes Schedule 82/tax adjustments, power-factor/contract provisions and connection costs. Parcel eligibility unconfirmed; holding this present standard rate constant for ten operating years is a sensitivity, not future approved prices.
limitation.zh: 2026年4月1日常规20费率，非2030年到期的20EV优惠。假设每月电量均匀，峰值1200/500/300kW，全部情景接入负荷1200kW，最低日费按接入负荷计算。未计82号调整/税、功率因数/合同条款及接网成本。本站适用未确认；将当前标准固定十个运营年仅为敏感性，非未来已批价格。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.zh: SnoPUD声明向整个斯诺霍米什县供电，因此该地址供电归属证据加强。

limitation.en: No charger rights, spare electrical capacity or project approval established.
limitation.zh: 不证明充电站权利、电力余量或项目批准。

claim.en: Ordinary Schedule 20 has a connected-load minimum; optional 20EV expires at the end of 2030.
claim.zh: 普通20号费率有连接负荷最低账单；可选20EV于2030年底到期。

limitation.en: Use the ordinary tariff for a durable sensitivity. Temporary discounts cannot be extended through a 10-year model without evidence.
limitation.zh: 长期敏感性应使用普通费率；无证据不得把临时折扣延伸到十年。

claim.zh: EVgo在同一地址列出4个现有车位：100kW、双枪共享350kW及100kW。

limitation.zh: 4个车位不等于4台350kW；在线率、利用率、价格和独家权未确认。

remainingCritical.en: Executed landlord/tenant parking rights, rent, exclusivity and term.
remainingCritical.zh: 已签业主/租户停车权、租金、独家限制及期限。

remainingCritical.en: Point of delivery, available grid capacity, full tariff, connection quote and date.
remainingCritical.zh: 接入点、电力余量、完整费率、接入报价及日期。

remainingCritical.en: EV-specific engineering, permits, environmental constraints and complete EPC quote.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电站专用工程、许可、环境约束及完整EPC报价。

remainingCritical.en: Measured paid demand, competing utilization and realizable selling prices.
remainingCritical.zh: 实测付费需求、竞争站利用率及可实现售价。

changesToPrior.en: Source-qualified findings added; no site-control, capacity, cost or demand gate is promoted to verified.
changesToPrior.zh: 补充分类证据；不将场地控制、容量、成本或需求门槛提升为已核实。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Pending. Existing on-site EVgo supply is a concrete demand-sharing risk. The standard-rate sensitivity cannot rely on the temporary EV discount or establish incremental paid demand.

title.en: Existing-site expansion / redesign hypothesis
title.zh: 既有场地扩容或重设计假设

rationale.en: Investigate expansion or redesign of an existing charging property. Recovered plans make a scope-matched cost check actionable; this is not a blank-market greenfield recommendation.
rationale.zh: 调查既有充电物业的扩容或重设计。已取得历史图纸，便于核对相同设计范围的成本；不是空白市场新增站推荐。

anchors.en: The official store address and historical BLD2022-0061 charging plans are documented. Existing supply is recorded at the property, with 55 DCFC records within 10 miles.
anchors.zh: 已有官方门店地址及历史BLD2022-0061充电设计。物业已有充电供给记录，10英里内共有55条快充记录。

counter.en: Historical design load is not spare capacity. Existing operator rights and nearby competition may defeat third-party entry. Reuse savings and incremental demand remain unproved.
counter.zh: 历史设计负荷不是剩余容量。既有运营商权利及竞品可能阻止第三方进入；复用节省和增量需求未证实。

test.en: Identify current equipment, operator and host rights; obtain paid throughput and as-built condition. Compare a genuine upgrade quote with a new four-post build, including only assets demonstrably reusable.
test.zh: 查明现有设备、运营商及场地权利，取得付费电量和竣工状态。把真实升级报价与新建四枪比较，只计入确认可复用的资产。

estimate.kind: vendor projection; not measured paid demand

design.en: Four-post new-build comparison; upgrade savings are not assumed.
design.zh: 四枪全新建设比较；未假定改造可节省成本。

官方按地址城市 Everett 汇总：纯电动车 3878 辆、插混 924 辆；不代表物业商圈。

reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.
reason.zh: 沿用的储备物业，本轮未重新打开原始来源核查。场地、电力、报价、需求和合同关键证据仍缺，不进入任一正式榜单。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

title.en: Snohomish PUD standard Schedule 20
title.zh: Snohomish PUD常规20费率

limitation.en: April 1, 2026 standard Schedule 20, not promotional 20EV (expires 2030). Assumes uniform monthly energy, peaks 1200/500/300kW and connected load 1200kW in all scenarios; minimum daily bill reflects connected load. Excludes Schedule 82/tax adjustments, power-factor/contract provisions and connection costs. Parcel eligibility unconfirmed; holding this present standard rate constant for ten operating years is a sensitivity, not future approved prices.
limitation.zh: 2026年4月1日常规20费率，非2030年到期的20EV优惠。假设每月电量均匀，峰值1200/500/300kW，全部情景接入负荷1200kW，最低日费按接入负荷计算。未计82号调整/税、功率因数/合同条款及接网成本。本站适用未确认；将当前标准固定十个运营年仅为敏感性，非未来已批价格。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Oregon commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Oregon州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。
