facts.claim: 官方物业名称与邮政地址；营业时间 07:00–22:00 每日

reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.
reason.zh: 沿用的储备物业，本轮未重新打开原始来源核查。场地、电力、报价、需求和合同关键证据仍缺，不进入任一正式榜单。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Georgia commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Georgia州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: Big V announced its 2024 acquisition with Equity Street Capital; the SEC collateral filing names borrower BVE Johns SPE LLC and manager Big V Properties LLC.
claim.zh: Big V披露2024年与Equity Street Capital收购；SEC抵押贷款披露借款实体为BVE Johns SPE LLC、管理人为Big V Properties LLC。

limitation.en: First-party transaction and financing disclosures are dated; no current deed, charger lease or lender consent was obtained.
limitation.zh: 交易及融资的一手披露有时间局限；尚未取得最新地契、充电租约或贷款方同意。

claim.en: The 2024 SEC filing describes a31.7 acre fee-interest center with 1,643 surface parking spaces; four adjacent outparcels are excluded from loan collateral.
claim.zh: 2024年SEC备案描述31.7英亩永久产权商场，含1,643个地面车位；4个相邻独立铺位不属于抵押物。

limitation.en: Historical disclosed count is not an as-built survey or spaces available to chargers. Do not mix excluded parcels into the usable site.
limitation.zh: 历史披露数量不是竣工测绘或充电可用车位数；不能将抵押范围外地块计入可使用面积。

claim.en: Sprouts'30,355sf lease was disclosed to expire September 30,2029 with two five-year extension options.
claim.zh: Sprouts的30,355平方英尺租约披露于2029年9月30日到期，并有两次五年续租选择权。

limitation.en: Historic tenant lease, not a charger lease; option exercise/current amendments unknown. Cannot assume a10-year charger tenure from tenant presence.
limitation.zh: 属于历史商户租约，非充电场地租约；续租权行使及最新修订未知，不能从商户存在推断10年充电经营权。

claim.en: The lender disclosure summarizes a May 3,2024 PhaseI assessment as finding no recognized environmental conditions.
claim.zh: 贷款披露摘要称2024年5月3日一期环境评估未发现需识别的环境条件。

limitation.en: The underlying PhaseI report was not retrieved; this is a secondhand technical finding, not current environmental clearance or charger civil approval.
limitation.zh: 未取得一期环境评估底稿；属于技术结论转述，不是当前环境许可或充电土建批准。

claim.en: JLL's undated brochure reports 21,500 vehicles/day on McGinnis Ferry Road and 44,200on Medlock Bridge Road.
claim.zh: JLL未注明日期的宣传册列McGinnis Ferry Road日车流21,500、Medlock Bridge Road日车流44,200。

limitation.en: No count year/station or DOT matching was supplied. Treat as broker proxy only; do not convert to sessions or add intersecting flows.
limitation.zh: 未提供统计年份、计数站或DOT匹配，只能作为经纪代理数据；不得换算充电订单，也不得相加路口车流。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger-site lease/easement, exclusivity and enforceable public-access term; ownership disclosure is insufficient.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电场地已签署租约/地役权、排他权及可执行开放期限；业主信息不足以替代合同。

remainingCritical.en: Utility-confirmed meter/service territory, import capacity, upgrades, connection price and energization date.
remainingCritical.zh: 电力公司确认的电表/供电范围、可用受电容量、增容方案、接电成本及送电日期。

remainingCritical.en: Charger-specific civil/electrical layout, permits, environmental and accessibility review, and complete EPC/operating quotations.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电项目专属土建电气布局、许可、环境及无障碍审查、完整EPC与运营报价。

remainingCritical.en: Measured local charging sessions, captured prices and competitor utilization; corridor/customer traffic is not paid charging demand.
remainingCritical.zh: 本地充电订单实测、实际售价及竞品利用率；道路/商场客流不等于付费充电需求。

remainingCritical.en: Contracted Tesla equipment/network access and revenue economics for each ownership perspective.
remainingCritical.zh: 两种投资视角各自的特斯拉设备/网络接入合同与收入分配条件。

remainingCritical.en: Verify fee parcel/common-area rights and whether BVE Johns SPE LLC and lender/anchor consents govern the chosen stalls; reconcile lease horizon beyond 2029.
remainingCritical.zh: 核实拟选车位所属永久产权宗地/公共区域，以及BVE Johns SPE LLC、贷款方与主力租户同意要求；解决2029年后的权利期限。

changesToPrior: Owner/borrower/manager route now identified.
A dated financing disclosure supplies parking count and exclusions, stronger than old marketing counts.
2029anchor lease expiry and optional extensions add a concrete tenure risk.
Traffic and PhaseI findings remain labeled proxies/secondary technical summaries.

publicResearchConclusion.en: Remain pending; parking scale is better documented, but usable stalls and a long enforceable term remain unproven. The 2029 anchor lease horizon prevents assuming unconstrained 10-year occupancy.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 仍待核；停车规模有更强依据，但可用车位与长期可执行权利未获证明。主力店2029年租约到期使直接假定10年稳定经营不成立。

attempts.outcome: Opened Big V own transaction announcement and original SEC collateral term sheet Loan6.
SEC1,643spaces conflicts with an older LoopNet2,289listing; retained datedSEC figure and did not adopt the older count.
Opened JLL brochure; no dated matchedDOT station or local paid-charging utilization found.
Exact-address and center-name searches did not establish the serving meter; GeorgiaPower/Sawnee region references are not enough.

summary.en: A secondary posted-price snapshot and the exact historical meter/OCPP disclosure request are available. Actual paid sessions, delivered kWh, realized prices, uptime and current incremental demand are still unavailable.
summary.zh: 取得次级挂牌价快照和明确的历史电表/OCPP披露请求；实际付费次数、交付电量、实收价格、可用率及当前新增需求仍未取得。

neededDocument.en: Public responses/exhibits to the 2022 subpoena; 12 months of current timestamped session and meter exports with paid/free/refund separation, net prices and uptime; a defensible incremental-demand study for the proposed project.
neededDocument.zh: 2022年传票的公开答复/证据附件；当前连续12个月带时间戳的充电和电表导出，区分付费/免费/退款、净价与可用率；拟建项目可论证的新增需求研究。

provider.en: Georgia PSC Open Records Officer for existing public case records; Electrify America and the metering utility with operator/owner authorization for current exports.
provider.zh: Georgia PSC公开记录官提供既有公开案卷；经运营商/业主授权由Electrify America及计量供电公司提供当前导出。

route.en: First retrieve docket 43899 public response/exhibit inventory. If absent, an authorized written records request can name document 188229 and its January 2022 hearing; ask which responsive records exist and which public versions can be released. Obtain current operational data separately under consent; reconcile sessions to delivered kWh and receipts. No request or outreach was made.
route.zh: 先取得43899案公开答复/附件目录；如仍缺失，可在获授权后书面申请，指明188229号文及2022年1月听证，要求说明存在哪些响应资料、哪些公开版本可提供。当前运营数据另行经同意获取，并将次数与交付电量及收款核对。本轮未申请或联系外部。

summary.en: No complete EV-specific capital or recurring-cost package was retrieved. Public property finance, historic retail leases and an indexed tenant-fit-out permit cannot price a new charging project. Existing EA assets cannot be assumed reusable or free.
summary.zh: 未取得完整的充电项目资本或经常性成本包。公开地产融资、历史商铺租约及索引中的租户装修许可不能给新充电项目定价；不能假设既有EA资产可复用或免费。

neededDocument.en: An approved new-build/expansion layout; itemized EVSE, civil, electrical, switchgear, transformer/CIAC, design, permits and contingency quotes; executed rent/revenue share, tariff, maintenance, software/payment, insurance and replacement schedules; treatment of existing EA equipment and rights.
neededDocument.zh: 确认的新建/扩建平面方案；设备、土建、电气、开关柜、变压器/CIAC、设计、许可与预备费的分项报价；已签租金/分成、电价、运维、软件/支付、保险及更换计划；既有EA设备与权利的处理方式。

provider.en: Current owner and asset manager, existing EA license holder, qualified EVSE EPC/vendor and Georgia Power after current service confirmation.
provider.zh: 当前业主与资产管理人、既有EA场地使用权主体、有资质的充电站EPC/设备商，以及当前供电确认后的Georgia Power。

route.en: Confirm title, parking rights, current leases and incumbent exclusivity before defining scope. Obtain comparable-scope EPC, utility and operating quotations. Ask the county for EV-specific approved plans/permits only as scope evidence; permit valuation alone is not a full-cost budget. No RFQ or records submission was sent.
route.zh: 先确认产权、停车权、当前租约及既有运营商排他条款，再定义工程范围。取得同口径EPC、供电与运营报价。向县主管部门获取充电工程专属批准图纸/许可用于核定范围；许可申报造价本身不是完整预算。本轮未发询价或资料申请。

summary.en: Historic Georgia Power single-meter service and the four-port / 1,140 kW cabinet-nameplate configuration are supported by a court opinion, with later review denial on the Supreme Court website. Current transformer/feeder headroom, incremental-load approval, connection costs and energization dates remain unverified.
summary.zh: 法院判决支持历史Georgia Power单表供电、4接口及功率柜总铭牌1,140 kW配置，最高法院官网另可核对后续拒绝复审。当前变压器/馈线余量、新增负荷批准、接电成本及送电日期仍未核实。

neededDocument.en: Current service agreement and tariff, as-built one-line, meter/transformer ratings, measured peak and load-management settings; owner-authorized incremental-load feasibility and a written utility offer specifying capacity, CIAC/upgrades and schedule.
neededDocument.zh: 当前供电合同与电价、竣工单线图、电表/变压器参数、实测峰值及负荷管理设置；经业主授权的新增负荷可行性研究，以及列明容量、CIAC/增容和工期的书面供电方案。

provider.en: Georgia Power as the documented historical serving utility, subject to current contract confirmation; Electrify America for as-built and load-control records; PSC for historical public exhibits.
provider.zh: Georgia Power为历史记录中的供电公司，仍需确认当前合同；Electrify America提供竣工与负荷控制资料；PSC提供历史公开附件。

route.en: Use the historical case to identify the right service/account route, then obtain owner consent and reconcile the current one-line, meter and EA load controls. Submit a defined incremental load only after project scope and rights are confirmed; require a utility capacity/cost/schedule offer. The 1,140 kW nameplate is not added capacity. No application was submitted.
route.zh: 利用历史案卷定位正确的供电/账户路径，再取得业主同意并核对当前单线图、电表及EA负荷控制。仅在工程范围与场地权利确认后提交明确的新增负荷，要求电力公司给出容量/成本/工期方案。1,140 kW铭牌不代表新增容量。本轮未提交申请。

priorityReason.en: Highest southern research priority: exact-site regulatory proceedings offer a rare route to actual historic load and service configuration; current data may still be confidential.
priorityReason.zh: 南部最高调查优先级：本址监管案卷可能提供历史实测负荷与供电配置；当前数据仍可能保密。

claim.en: A January 11, 2022 PSC subpoena in docket 43899 identifies the 3630 Peachtree Parkway charging premises and demands 2021 meter/load records and power-limit settings.
claim.zh: 2022年1月11日PSC案卷43899传票明确指向3630 Peachtree Parkway充电场地，要求提供2021年电表、负荷及功率限制记录。

limitation.en: The request does not contain returned observations, current utilization, net margin or a spare-capacity commitment.
limitation.zh: 传票要求本身不含已交付数据、当前利用率、净利润或剩余容量承诺。

attempts.result: Bounded search screened; no qualifying complete local paid-demand/cost/capacity package found. Relevant opened sources listed separately.
Bounded search screened; no qualifying complete local paid-demand/cost/capacity package found. Relevant opened sources listed separately.
Bounded search screened; no qualifying complete local paid-demand/cost/capacity package found. Relevant opened sources listed separately.
Bounded search screened; no qualifying complete local paid-demand/cost/capacity package found. Relevant opened sources listed separately.
Opened and scoped; partial evidence only.
Opened and scoped; partial evidence only.
Opened and scoped; partial evidence only.
Accessible page requires JavaScript; retrieved text did not expose station detail or utilization.

selectionReason.en: Highest southern research priority: exact-site regulatory proceedings offer a rare route to actual historic load and service configuration; current data may still be confidential.
selectionReason.zh: 南部最高调查优先级：本址监管案卷可能提供历史实测负荷与供电配置；当前数据仍可能保密。

claim.en: The March 13, 2024 Court of Appeals opinion A23A1381, reproduced by Justia and FindLaw, describes the disputed Suwanee Electrify America site as four charging ports (two rated 150 kW and two rated 350 kW), six power cabinets rated 190 kW each, and a 1,140 kW total cabinet nameplate rating. Georgia Power supplied AC through one meter.
claim.zh: Justia及FindLaw转载的2024年3月13日上诉法院A23A1381判决，描述涉案Suwanee Electrify America旧站有4个充电接口（2个150 kW、2个350 kW）、6个各190 kW功率柜，总铭牌功率1,140 kW，由Georgia Power通过单一电表提供交流电。

limitation.en: Court-authored text is accessed through secondary hosts; the opinion identifies the Suwanee dispute, while the original PSC subpoena supplies the street-address join. These are historic existing-EA equipment facts, not current 2026 as-built verification, observed utilization, transformer capacity, or spare/reserved capacity for a new eight-stall project.
limitation.zh: 法院原文经次级网站访问；判决指明Suwanee争议，PSC原始传票用于关联具体门牌。这是既有EA旧站的历史设备信息，不是2026年竣工复核、实际利用率、变压器容量或新增8车位项目的可用/预留容量。

claim.en: The Supreme Court of Georgia official list records denial of certiorari on February 18, 2025 in S24C0906, explicitly linked to A23A1381. The earlier appellate opinion affirmed the decision authorizing Georgia Power to serve this historical EA installation.
claim.zh: Georgia最高法院官方名单记载，2025年2月18日拒绝对S24C0906复审，并明确关联A23A1381；此前上诉判决维持Georgia Power为该历史EA设施供电的裁定。

limitation.en: The denial is verified on the court website; the substance of the earlier decision is read through a court-opinion mirror. This resolves a historical supplier dispute, not a new service commitment, current tariff election, technical expansion approval or a Supreme Court merits ruling.
limitation.zh: 拒绝复审直接核自法院网站；此前判决内容经法院文书转载读取。该记录解决的是历史供电争议，不是新供电承诺、当前适用电价、扩建技术许可或最高法院对实体问题的重新裁判。

claim.en: The original January 11, 2022 subpoena in PSC docket 43899 names Johns Creek Town Center, 3630 Peachtree Parkway, and requests AC/DC meter readings and metered demand/usage/load for March 1–December 31, 2021, plus OCPP configuration and power-limit records.
claim.zh: PSC案卷43899的2022年1月11日原始传票指明Johns Creek Town Center、3630 Peachtree Parkway，要求提供2021年3月1日至12月31日交流/直流电表读数、计量需量/用量/负荷，以及OCPP配置和功率限制资料。

limitation.en: No response containing those measurements was retrieved. A request for data is not data. Item 6 concerns a 250 kVA transformer at Cookeville, Tennessee, not this Suwanee site. Even historic delivered energy would not establish current paid sessions or incremental Tesla demand.
limitation.zh: 尚未取得含这些实测数据的答复。要求提供数据不等于取得数据。第6项所述250 kVA变压器位于Tennessee的Cookeville，不能套用于Suwanee；即使取得历史电量，也不能证明当前付费次数或新增Tesla需求。

claim.en: DCFC Tracker lists this exact address with four CCS stalls and a posted $0.64/kWh price. The final page opened in this audit attributes that price to Electrify America with a September 3, 2026 source date.
claim.zh: DCFC Tracker在该准确地址列出4个CCS车位和$0.64/kWh挂牌价；本轮最后打开的正文将价格来源标为Electrify America、日期为2026年9月3日。

limitation.en: Earlier retrieval exposed a different freshness date, so cached freshness is inconsistent. The official EA page did not expose station details in retrieved text. This is an unverified secondary posted-price snapshot, not a current confirmed price, realized net price, paid-order count or revenue; no underwriting input is replaced.
limitation.zh: 前次抓取显示不同的新鲜度日期，缓存日期存在不一致；EA官方页面的可读正文没有显示站点细节。这是未获官方确认的次级挂牌价快照，不是已确认的当前价格、实收净价、付费订单或收入，不替换承销模型输入。

claim.en: The July 23, 2024 SEC filing for Johns Creek Town Center uses an April 3, 2024 rent roll and lists Sprouts expiry as September 30, 2029 with two five-year options. Big V announced its acquisition with Equity Street Capital on June 11, 2024.
claim.zh: 2024年7月23日SEC披露中的Johns Creek Town Center资料使用2024年4月3日租赁表，列示Sprouts于2029年9月30日到期、另有两次5年续租选择权。Big V于2024年6月11日公告与Equity Street Capital的收购。

limitation.en: These are dated owner/issuer disclosures, not an executed charging-site lease or current title confirmation. Renewal exercise, EA exclusivity, parking easements, mortgage/tenant consent and EV rent/revenue share are unverified. Property acquisition, mortgage and retail operating costs are not EV capex or opex.
limitation.zh: 这些是有日期的业主/发行人披露，不是已签署的充电场地合同或当前产权确认。续租是否行权、EA排他条款、停车地役权、抵押权人/租户同意及充电租金/分成尚未核实；地产收购、贷款和商场运营费用不能替代EV资本与运营成本。

claim.en: Georgia PSC publishes a written Open Records Act request route through its Open Records Officer at openrecords@psc.ga.gov. The precise next document targets are docket 43899 subpoena responses, the January 2022 hearing exhibit index, public technical exhibits, the adopted initial/final orders, and any public versions of withheld material.
claim.zh: Georgia PSC公布了向Open Records Officer（openrecords@psc.ga.gov）提交书面公开记录申请的路径。下一步具体文件是43899案传票答复、2022年1月听证证据目录、可公开技术附件、获采纳的初步/最终裁定，以及受限资料的公开版本。

limitation.en: No request was submitted. Live PSC page access failed DNS in shell/browser; indexed original documents remained accessible. The docket table did not render records. We did not locate the requested measurements and cannot determine whether they are unindexed, never filed publicly, or protected; confidentiality is not asserted without an actual withholding record.
limitation.zh: 本轮未提交申请。终端/浏览器现场访问PSC域名发生DNS失败，但索引中的原始文书可读取；案卷表格未呈现记录。未找到所需实测资料，无法确定是未索引、未公开入卷还是受保护；没有真实的不公开说明时不声称资料保密。

attempts.result: Read complete 4-page subpoena and filed-date metadata. Requests AC/DC data, OCPP/power limits; provides no observations. Cookeville transformer request excluded from Suwanee facts.

attempts.query: Open docket 43899 live public filing directory
attempts.result: Retrieved text showed a dynamic empty table. Shell curl and a hidden browser attempt could not resolve PSC host. Do not interpret the table as a genuinely empty docket or its displayed status as current legal status.

attempts.query: Open indexed Georgia Power subpoena request, document 188236
attempts.result: Search lead described a January 11, 2022 subpoena request with a ZIP attachment. Original open returned cache miss; no ZIP contents verified and no attachment URL invented.
Read 7-page original: objection to RaceTrac intervention, not a response to EA usage subpoena. No measured station usage/cost package.

attempts.query: Open A23A1381 opinion and cross-check second host
attempts.result: Read full court opinion through Justia and FindLaw; original PDF was readable once, but later PDF screenshot/open returned cache/access error. Matching hosts reproduce the same opinion, not independent measurements. Historical equipment/service facts verified in text.
No usable court-hosted opinion returned in bounded search; hosting limitation remains explicit.

attempts.query: Verify Supreme Court S24C0906 / A23A1381 disposition
attempts.result: Official court page lists February 18, 2025 denial. No inference of new technical approval or merits ruling.

attempts.query: Open exact-address EA station and DCFC Tracker
attempts.result: EA retrieved text was a generic JavaScript locator. Secondary tracker final opening listed $0.64/kWh dated September 3, 2026; an earlier retrieval exposed another freshness date. Source-date inconsistency retained; no current price or volume confirmation.

attempts.query: Open original SEC loan-6 disclosure and Big V acquisition announcement
attempts.result: Read April 3, 2024 rent-roll date and Sprouts 2029 expiry / two five-year options; no exercise assumed. Retail property economics and mortgage amounts excluded from EV costs.

attempts.result: Original returned 403. Search index described BLDGCOMM-21-0379 at 3630 Peachtree Pkwy #701 as tenant finish; not verified as EV scope and not used as charging cost.
No usable exact-site EV engineering permit or complete-cost package returned.
Original final order not retrieved in bounded search. Do not present secondary transcript footnote as a read original order.
Search index of another docket transcript cites an August 23, 2022 order adopting the initial decision. Lead only; original order and full transcript were not opened in this pass.
No relevant public response or withholding/redaction determination returned; confidentiality remains unknown.
No qualifying returned measurements or OCPP exhibits found.

attempts.query: Open Georgia Senate PSC EV Territorial Act presentation
attempts.result: Original timed out. No facts promoted from index.

attempts.query: site:psc.ga.gov open records request records custodian; open official route
attempts.result: Read official written-request route and Open Records Officer address. No contact or request submitted.

summary.en: A secondary posted-price snapshot and the exact historical meter/OCPP disclosure request are available. Actual paid sessions, delivered kWh, realized prices, uptime and current incremental demand are still unavailable.
summary.zh: 取得次级挂牌价快照和明确的历史电表/OCPP披露请求；实际付费次数、交付电量、实收价格、可用率及当前新增需求仍未取得。

neededDocument.en: Public responses/exhibits to the 2022 subpoena; 12 months of current timestamped session and meter exports with paid/free/refund separation, net prices and uptime; a defensible incremental-demand study for the proposed project.
neededDocument.zh: 2022年传票的公开答复/证据附件；当前连续12个月带时间戳的充电和电表导出，区分付费/免费/退款、净价与可用率；拟建项目可论证的新增需求研究。

provider.en: Georgia PSC Open Records Officer for existing public case records; Electrify America and the metering utility with operator/owner authorization for current exports.
provider.zh: Georgia PSC公开记录官提供既有公开案卷；经运营商/业主授权由Electrify America及计量供电公司提供当前导出。

route.en: First retrieve docket 43899 public response/exhibit inventory. If absent, an authorized written records request can name document 188229 and its January 2022 hearing; ask which responsive records exist and which public versions can be released. Obtain current operational data separately under consent; reconcile sessions to delivered kWh and receipts. No request or outreach was made.
route.zh: 先取得43899案公开答复/附件目录；如仍缺失，可在获授权后书面申请，指明188229号文及2022年1月听证，要求说明存在哪些响应资料、哪些公开版本可提供。当前运营数据另行经同意获取，并将次数与交付电量及收款核对。本轮未申请或联系外部。

summary.en: No complete EV-specific capital or recurring-cost package was retrieved. Public property finance, historic retail leases and an indexed tenant-fit-out permit cannot price a new charging project. Existing EA assets cannot be assumed reusable or free.
summary.zh: 未取得完整的充电项目资本或经常性成本包。公开地产融资、历史商铺租约及索引中的租户装修许可不能给新充电项目定价；不能假设既有EA资产可复用或免费。

neededDocument.en: An approved new-build/expansion layout; itemized EVSE, civil, electrical, switchgear, transformer/CIAC, design, permits and contingency quotes; executed rent/revenue share, tariff, maintenance, software/payment, insurance and replacement schedules; treatment of existing EA equipment and rights.
neededDocument.zh: 确认的新建/扩建平面方案；设备、土建、电气、开关柜、变压器/CIAC、设计、许可与预备费的分项报价；已签租金/分成、电价、运维、软件/支付、保险及更换计划；既有EA设备与权利的处理方式。

provider.en: Current owner and asset manager, existing EA license holder, qualified EVSE EPC/vendor and Georgia Power after current service confirmation.
provider.zh: 当前业主与资产管理人、既有EA场地使用权主体、有资质的充电站EPC/设备商，以及当前供电确认后的Georgia Power。

route.en: Confirm title, parking rights, current leases and incumbent exclusivity before defining scope. Obtain comparable-scope EPC, utility and operating quotations. Ask the county for EV-specific approved plans/permits only as scope evidence; permit valuation alone is not a full-cost budget. No RFQ or records submission was sent.
route.zh: 先确认产权、停车权、当前租约及既有运营商排他条款，再定义工程范围。取得同口径EPC、供电与运营报价。向县主管部门获取充电工程专属批准图纸/许可用于核定范围；许可申报造价本身不是完整预算。本轮未发询价或资料申请。

summary.en: Historic Georgia Power single-meter service and the four-port / 1,140 kW cabinet-nameplate configuration are supported by a court opinion, with later review denial on the Supreme Court website. Current transformer/feeder headroom, incremental-load approval, connection costs and energization dates remain unverified.
summary.zh: 法院判决支持历史Georgia Power单表供电、4接口及功率柜总铭牌1,140 kW配置，最高法院官网另可核对后续拒绝复审。当前变压器/馈线余量、新增负荷批准、接电成本及送电日期仍未核实。

neededDocument.en: Current service agreement and tariff, as-built one-line, meter/transformer ratings, measured peak and load-management settings; owner-authorized incremental-load feasibility and a written utility offer specifying capacity, CIAC/upgrades and schedule.
neededDocument.zh: 当前供电合同与电价、竣工单线图、电表/变压器参数、实测峰值及负荷管理设置；经业主授权的新增负荷可行性研究，以及列明容量、CIAC/增容和工期的书面供电方案。

provider.en: Georgia Power as the documented historical serving utility, subject to current contract confirmation; Electrify America for as-built and load-control records; PSC for historical public exhibits.
provider.zh: Georgia Power为历史记录中的供电公司，仍需确认当前合同；Electrify America提供竣工与负荷控制资料；PSC提供历史公开附件。

route.en: Use the historical case to identify the right service/account route, then obtain owner consent and reconcile the current one-line, meter and EA load controls. Submit a defined incremental load only after project scope and rights are confirmed; require a utility capacity/cost/schedule offer. The 1,140 kW nameplate is not added capacity. No application was submitted.
route.zh: 利用历史案卷定位正确的供电/账户路径，再取得业主同意并核对当前单线图、电表及EA负荷控制。仅在工程范围与场地权利确认后提交明确的新增负荷，要求电力公司给出容量/成本/工期方案。1,140 kW铭牌不代表新增容量。本轮未提交申请。

assessmentChange.en: Research confidence improves for the historical serving utility, existing four-port EA configuration and case disposition. The candidate remains pending in both rankings: no current paid-demand export, complete project cost, enforceable site control or utility offer for incremental capacity. None of the hard gates or scenario inputs changes; a new eight-stall site cannot be inferred from the incumbent four-port station.
assessmentChange.zh: 历史供电公司、既有4接口EA配置及案件处置的证据更清晰。两个榜单均仍待核：缺少当前付费需求导出、完整项目成本、可执行场地权及针对新增容量的供电方案。硬门槛与情景模型输入均不改变，不能从既有4接口站推定新增8车位项目已具备条件。

decisionChange.en: Research confidence improves for the historical serving utility, existing four-port EA configuration and case disposition. The candidate remains pending in both rankings: no current paid-demand export, complete project cost, enforceable site control or utility offer for incremental capacity. None of the hard gates or scenario inputs changes; a new eight-stall site cannot be inferred from the incumbent four-port station.
decisionChange.zh: 历史供电公司、既有4接口EA配置及案件处置的证据更清晰。两个榜单均仍待核：缺少当前付费需求导出、完整项目成本、可执行场地权及针对新增容量的供电方案。硬门槛与情景模型输入均不改变，不能从既有4接口站推定新增8车位项目已具备条件。

headline.en: A current utility funding route improves the development option; actual records remain missing.
headline.zh: 当前公用事业资金支持路径改善了开发选项；实测记录仍缺。

impact.en: Investigate a utility-funded public charging design before assuming all make-ready cost is investor-funded. No award, quote, meter history, CIEV enrollment or incremental capacity was obtained.
impact.zh: 应先核实公用事业承担部分接电配套的公共快充方案，再假设全部由投资者出资。尚无获批资助、报价、电表历史、CIEV注册或增量容量。

claim.en: The 2026–2028 Make Ready criteria cap normal program investment at $300,000 per project. Public-facing retail is eligible in principle; at least one DC fast charger is required. Georgia Power owns behind-meter infrastructure; the customer may owe costs above the cap. Future-proofing is excluded.
claim.zh: 2026–2028年Make Ready通常每项目上限30万美元，公共零售场地原则上可申请，至少一台DC快充；表后基础设施由Georgia Power持有，超额可由客户承担，未来预埋扩容不予资助。

limitation.en: The cap is not a WinCo/Sprouts award or quote. Utility criteria and signed project scope control; do not subtract $300,000 from existing capex.
limitation.zh: 该上限不是本场地获批金额或报价，不得从现有建设成本直接减去30万美元。

claim.en: Program terms require property authority and acceptance, with separate funding confirmation. The current page schedules funding through December 31, 2028 or budget exhaustion; site assessment and approved design precede equipment orders.
claim.zh: 项目条款要求物业授权及审批，并另行确认资金；现行页面有效期至2028年12月31日或资金用尽，现场评估和批准设计先于设备订购。

limitation.en: An older general FAQ still says 2022; current 2026–2028 criteria and current program page supersede that stale date. No signed acceptance, site visit or capacity result obtained.
limitation.zh: 旧FAQ仍写2022年，应以现行2026–2028标准及项目页为准。未取得签署接受文件、现场评估或容量结果。

claim.en: CIEV-1 applies on request to a dedicated EV meter under PL tariffs, excluding RTP. Billing-demand factors are 0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80 for bills 1–12/13–24/25–36/37–48, ending sooner when rolling 12-month load factor reaches 15%.
claim.zh: CIEV-1须申请，适用PL费率下独立EV电表，不适用RTP；第1至4年计费需量系数为0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80，滚动12个月负荷率达到15%则提前结束。

limitation.en: This is temporary bill relief, not an energy price or firm capacity. Existing-account history, rate class and new-meter eligibility are unknown; no model deduction made.
limitation.zh: 这是临时需量账单优惠，不是电价或确定容量；现有账户历史、费率和新电表资格未知，未在模型抵减。

attempts.action: PSC43899 indexed exhibits, meter readings, EA subpoena response
attempts.result: Only the known subpoena and docket shell surfaced. A demand to produce records is not the response or measured data.

attempts.action: Public docket direct retrieval
attempts.result: Web table returned No records found; direct curl and browser failed DNS. This is retrieval failure, not an empty docket.

attempts.action: Current Georgia Power EV cost assistance and rider originals
attempts.result: Retrieved five-page 2026–2028 criteria, six-page terms and one-page tariff. Retained public PDFs for independent review.

demand.en: Public sources disclose program rules and historic configuration, not the operator transaction export, current accepted EPC budget or new utility service agreement. The historical PSC exhibit route could not be rendered/retrieved here. Needed: Public responses/exhibits to the 2022 subpoena; 12 months of current timestamped session and meter exports with paid/free/refund separation, net prices and uptime; a defensible incremental-demand study for the proposed project. Holder: Georgia PSC Open Records Officer for existing public case records; Electrify America and the metering utility with operator/owner authorization for current exports.

cost.en: Public sources disclose program rules and historic configuration, not the operator transaction export, current accepted EPC budget or new utility service agreement. The historical PSC exhibit route could not be rendered/retrieved here. Needed: An approved new-build/expansion layout; itemized EVSE, civil, electrical, switchgear, transformer/CIAC, design, permits and contingency quotes; executed rent/revenue share, tariff, maintenance, software/payment, insurance and replacement schedules; treatment of existing EA equipment and rights. Holder: Current owner and asset manager, existing EA license holder, qualified EVSE EPC/vendor and Georgia Power after current service confirmation.

Holder: Georgia Power as the documented historical serving utility, subject to current contract confirmation; Electrify America for as-built and load-control records; PSC for historical public exhibits.

Ask the county for EV-specific approved plans/permits only as scope evidence; permit valuation alone is not a full-cost budget. No RFQ or records submission was sent.
route.zh: 先确认产权、停车权、当前租约及既有运营商排他条款，再定义工程范围。取得同口径EPC、供电与运营报价。向县主管部门获取充电工程专属批准图纸/许可用于核定范围；许可申报造价本身不是完整预算。本轮未发询价或资料申请。

requestContent.en: An approved new-build/expansion layout; itemized EVSE, civil, electrical, switchgear, transformer/CIAC, design, permits and contingency quotes; executed rent/revenue share, tariff, maintenance, software/payment, insurance and replacement schedules; treatment of existing EA equipment and rights.
requestContent.zh: 确认的新建/扩建平面方案；设备、土建、电气、开关柜、变压器/CIAC、设计、许可与预备费的分项报价；已签租金/分成、电价、运维、软件/支付、保险及更换计划；既有EA设备与权利的处理方式。

reason.en: Public sources disclose program rules and historic configuration, not the operator transaction export, current accepted EPC budget or new utility service agreement. The historical PSC exhibit route could not be rendered/retrieved here.
reason.zh: 公开资料披露项目规则和历史设备配置，而非运营商交易导出、现行获批EPC预算或新增接电协议；本轮亦无法取得历史PSC证物列表。

provider.en: Georgia Power as the documented historical serving utility, subject to current contract confirmation; Electrify America for as-built and load-control records; PSC for historical public exhibits.
provider.zh: Georgia Power为历史记录中的供电公司，仍需确认当前合同；Electrify America提供竣工与负荷控制资料；PSC提供历史公开附件。

route.en: Use the historical case to identify the right service/account route, then obtain owner consent and reconcile the current one-line, meter and EA load controls. Submit a defined incremental load only after project scope and rights are confirmed; require a utility capacity/cost/schedule offer. The 1,140 kW nameplate is not added capacity. No application was submitted.
route.zh: 利用历史案卷定位正确的供电/账户路径，再取得业主同意并核对当前单线图、电表及EA负荷控制。仅在工程范围与场地权利确认后提交明确的新增负荷，要求电力公司给出容量/成本/工期方案。1,140 kW铭牌不代表新增容量。本轮未提交申请。

requestContent.en: Current service agreement and tariff, as-built one-line, meter/transformer ratings, measured peak and load-management settings; owner-authorized incremental-load feasibility and a written utility offer specifying capacity, CIAC/upgrades and schedule.
requestContent.zh: 当前供电合同与电价、竣工单线图、电表/变压器参数、实测峰值及负荷管理设置；经业主授权的新增负荷可行性研究，以及列明容量、CIAC/增容和工期的书面供电方案。

nextAction.en: Obtain docket43899 exhibit index and public subpoena responses first; separately ask EA for anonymized recent transactions and Georgia Power for account-rate history, CIEV eligibility, Make Ready allocation, customer CIAC and date-bound capacity letter under host authority.
nextAction.zh: 优先取得43899证物目录及公开传票回复；另向EA索取近期匿名交易，在业主授权下向Georgia Power索取账户费率历史、CIEV资格、Make Ready分摊、客户CIAC及带日期容量函。

reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Oregon commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Oregon州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

limitation.en: Unconfirmed Schedule 30 secondary/201 eligibility; assumes separate ordinary charging account, no applicable aggregated caps or self-direction, equal delivery/meter voltage, uniform monthly use and load size equal to 500/300 kW peak. The 1.5% public-purpose charge mapping to core energy/demand/basic/load-size charges is an explicit inference; it is not compounded on the four riders. Excludes reactive/special-contract or other unconfirmed charges and connection costs. Repeated 1200 kW is ineligible, so conservative is omitted. All current charges are held constant as a stress test, including public-purpose charges beyond their stated January 2036 term; no future tariff or complete bill is claimed.

claim.en: April 2026 Schedule 30 secondary summary: $13.07/kW combined demand and 6.537¢/kWh combined energy. Basic/load-size charges are $198 plus $2.45/kW for 201–300 kW load size, or $525 plus $1.20/kW above 300 kW.

limitation.en: Schedule 30 eligibility, secondary metering and Schedule 201 supply are conditional. Listed energy excludes 291/292, 91/92 and public-purpose charges. Repeated 1,200 kW demand is outside this schedule; no all-in bill is claimed.
limitation.zh: 30号适用性、二次侧计量及201号供能均有条件。电量价未含291/292、91/92及公共用途费用；反复1,200kW不在此费率范围，不宣称完整账单。

claim.en: Pacific Power offers Oregon nonresidential customers a no-cost on-site EV charging feasibility assessment, explicitly including public fast charging.
claim.zh: Pacific Power向俄勒冈非住宅客户提供免费现场充电可行性评估，明确包括公共快充。

limitation.en: Eligibility/application is not approval, a firm capacity reservation, a construction quote or a delivery guarantee. No application was submitted.
limitation.zh: 具备申请路径不等于已获批、容量保留、施工报价或交付保证；本轮未提交申请。

claim.en: No paid-order series or complete WinCo project budget was retrieved. The cancelled EV Gateway grant creates a specific path to seek application, budget and utility records from ODOT.
claim.zh: 未取得WinCo付费订单序列或完整项目预算；取消的EV Gateway补助提供向ODOT索取申请、预算及供电记录的具体路径。

limitation.en: The linked GovQA request portal redirected to a tool-inaccessible page. Records may be incomplete/redacted; cancellation letters and final approved site list must be checked before assigning a cause.
limitation.zh: 关联GovQA记录申请门户重定向后本工具无法访问；记录可能不全或删节，归因前须核查取消函与最终获批场地清单。

claim.en: Current original tariffs confirm four extra energy riders totaling 1.293 cents/kWh, giving 7.830 cents/kWh before Schedule 290. The 1.5% public-purpose basis is separately documented; its core-charge mapping is marked as an inference.
claim.zh: 现行原始费率确认四项电量附加费共1.293美分/kWh，加总至7.830美分/kWh，尚未计290号；1.5%公共用途费基数单独记录，其核心收费映射标为推导。

limitation.en: Applies only under the stated ordinary-account and cap assumptions; no actual site bill obtained. The proposal remains a conditional partial subtotal.
limitation.zh: 仅在列明普通账户及封顶假设下适用；未取得实际场地账单，仍为条件部分小计。

attempts.result: Original 2024 award-intent bulletin and current October 2026 cancellation notice read. No parcel budget, transaction history or cause-specific engineering report found; stale staging pages excluded.
attempts.method: bounded fresh web search and original-source text inspection

attempts.result: Agency map hyperlink encodes 251 E Barnett Rd, Medford OR 97501. Google Maps destination failed cache retrieval; address linkage is attributed to the agency hyperlink, not a separately opened Google record.
attempts.method: bounded fresh web search and original-source text inspection

attempts.result: Link redirects to odot.govqa.us and failed tool access. No records request sent.

attempts.result: Original PDFs read, including load-size history and demand applicability. No parcel classification or customer bill; no complete-bill claim.
attempts.method: bounded fresh web search and original-source text inspection

attempts.query: Pacific Power no-cost assessment eligibility and application
attempts.result: Original service page and lead form inspected; Oregon nonresidential and public fast charging supported. No submission or capacity result.

attempts.result: All six original PDFs read. Four kWh riders and caps verified; Schedule 290 exact revenue-category basis captured. Core-charge scaling explicitly inferred, not claimed as a complete bill. Schedule 101 lists Albany only.
attempts.method: original-source inspection and arithmetic check

summary.en: No observed paid-volume or realized-price series. A historical proposed NEVI site and subsequent corridor cancellation do not establish delivered charging demand.

neededDocument.zh: 12个月匿名付费订单、输出电量、实际净售价、停机及逐小时分布；拟建场地的增量需求与客户分流研究。

summary.zh: 已取得现行费率组成及取消项目记录路径；完整EPC、租约、运维与接电成本仍缺失，未扣除补助。

summary.en: Free on-site assessment and prior grant engineering-record routes identified; firm parcel capacity, connection cost and energization date remain unknown.
summary.zh: 已确认免费现场评估及历史补助工程记录路径；地块确定容量、接电费用和送电日期仍未知。

assessmentChange.en: Execution risk worsens: the prior corridor agreement containing the proposed WinCo location was cancelled. The cause is unresolved, so this is a priority hold for records review, not a finding that the parcel is technically impossible. Qualification remains pending.
assessmentChange.zh: 实施风险上升：包含该拟建WinCo地点的原走廊协议已取消。原因未明，应优先暂停并核查记录，不等于判定地块技术不可行；资格仍待核。

name.en: Pacific Power Oregon Schedule 30 secondary with Schedule 201 supply
name.zh: Pacific Power俄勒冈30号二次侧、201号供能条件小计

scope.en: Conditional delivery + Schedule 201 supply subtotal including four verified per-kWh riders, with an explicitly inferred Schedule 290 core-charge mapping. Not a complete utility bill or site qualification.
scope.zh: 条件输配电加201号供能小计，纳入四项已核实按电量附加费；290号对核心收费的映射明确标为推导。不是完整电费账单或场地达标证明。

numericInputs.meaning: Schedule 30 secondary combined energy before separately listed riders

loadSizeDefinition.en: Average of the two greatest nonzero monthly demands within the trailing 12 months including current month; this is not automatically the current billing peak.
loadSizeDefinition.zh: 含当月的前12个月两个最高非零月需量的平均，不自动等于当月计费峰值。

monthlyDemandDefinition.en: Greatest metered 15-minute use, rounded to nearest kW, minimum 100 kW.
monthlyDemandDefinition.zh: 当月最大15分钟计量需量，四舍五入至kW，最低100kW。

assumptions.en: Assume utility approves Schedule 30 secondary and Schedule 201 supply; assume meter voltage matches delivery voltage; assume steady history gives load size equal to each stated monthly peak. These are analytical inputs, not site observations.
assumptions.zh: 假设公用事业批准30号二次侧与201号供能、计量电压等于供电电压，且稳定历史令负荷规模等于列示月峰值；均为分析假设，并非场地实测。

riderSource.note: Current original tariff PDFs read 2026-10-30. Indexed Schedule 291 search excerpt was stale (2025 percentage-based scheme), so the opened current 2026 PDF controls this analysis. No BPA credit deducted.

limitations.en: Still excludes unknown reactive charges, meter-voltage adjustments and special-contract conditions. Schedule 290 mapping is an explicitly stated inference. Assumes Schedule 201 cost-based supply, secondary service, rate eligibility and no rider-cap adjustment. Repeated 1,200 kW remains outside Schedule 30. No full bill, firm capacity or approved local tariff assignment obtained.
limitations.zh: 仍未计未知无功费、计量电压调整及特别合同条件。290号映射明确为推导。假设201号成本供能、二次侧服务、适用资格成立且无需附加费封顶调整。反复1,200kW仍超出30号范围；未取得完整账单、确定容量或获批当地费率类别。

riderApplicabilityAssumptions.en: Separate ordinary charging account, no self-direction or aggregated-site exemption/cap applies, annual charging energy below 8,760 MWh; monthly grid energy remains below 724,638 kWh and 5,000,000 kWh. Test caps at actual site/account level, not only at the charger meter.
riderApplicabilityAssumptions.zh: 假设独立普通充电账户，无自主管理或合并场地减免/封顶，年度充电电量低于8,760MWh，月购电低于724,638kWh与5,000,000kWh。封顶须按实际场地/账户判断，不能只看充电电表。

publishedBasis.en: 1.5% of billed electricity, distribution, ancillary, metering/billing, transition and other cost categories included in electric rates on July 23, 1999. The price summary marks 1.5% on Schedule 30 basic, load-size, demand, energy and reactive rows.
publishedBasis.zh: 按电力、输配、辅助、计量/账务、过渡费及1999年7月23日电价已包含的其他成本类别计1.5%。费率汇总在30号基本费、负荷规模、需量、电量和无功行标注1.5%。

mapping.en: Apply 1.5% to the documented core basic/load-size/demand/combined-energy subtotal, then add the four separately stated kWh riders. Do not compound 1.5% onto those riders without utility confirmation. This billing mapping must be checked against an actual utility bill.
mapping.zh: 对已列明核心基本费/负荷规模/需量/合并电量小计计1.5%，再加四项单列按电量附加费；未经供电方确认，不对附加费再次复乘1.5%。该账单映射仍须与实际电费单核对。

implementationMapping.formula: monthlySubtotal = 1.015 * (basic + loadSizeRate * assumedLoadSizeKw + 13.07 * monthlyDemandKw + 0.06537 * monthlyGridKwh) + 0.01293 * monthlyGridKwh

rounding.en: Keep full precision through calculation, round the resulting displayed bill; utility line-by-line rounding may differ.
rounding.zh: 计算保留精度，最终显示金额再取舍；供电方逐项舍入可能不同。

municipalExactionCheck.en: Current Schedule 101 effective April 1, 2026 lists only City of Albany at 1.15%; it supplies no additional Medford-specific charge. This is not a comprehensive tax opinion.
municipalExactionCheck.zh: 2026年4月1日生效的101号仅列Albany市1.15%，未列Medford额外项目；这不构成全面税费判断。

decisionChange.en: Execution risk worsens: the prior corridor agreement containing the proposed WinCo location was cancelled. The cause is unresolved, so this is a priority hold for records review, not a finding that the parcel is technically impossible. Qualification remains pending.

headline.en: Round 3 creates a new funding option, not a recovered WinCo quote.
headline.zh: 第三轮提供新资助选项，并未取得WinCo报价。

impact.en: Cancelled Round 1 remains a delivery risk. A new round may support a redesigned project, but the site is not awarded and the corridor budget cannot substitute for cost.
impact.zh: 第一轮取消仍构成交付风险；新一轮可能支持重新设计的项目，但本场地未获批，走廊预算不能替代场地成本。

claim.en: Round 3 offers $2,333,835 on I-5 for at least four stations. It reimburses up to 80% of eligible cost with at least 20% match. Real-estate purchase, major off-site grid upgrades and most variable operating costs are excluded.
claim.zh: 第三轮为I-5至少4站提供2,333,835美元资金，最多报销合格成本80%，需至少20%配套；不含购地、重大场外电网扩容及大部分可变运营费用。

limitation.en: This is a competitive corridor envelope, not per-site construction cost, award, approval or available cash for WinCo. No subsidy is included in the model.
limitation.zh: 这是竞争性走廊预算，并非每址建设成本、获批或WinCo可用现金，模型未计补贴。

claim.en: The current scope template calls for final design, third-party contracts, signed utility-work agreement, final utility plans and a commissioning report with proof of energization; reimbursement requires actual invoices and payment proof.
claim.zh: 现行范围模板要求最终设计、第三方合同、签署的供电工程协议、最终公用事业图纸，以及含送电证明的调试报告；报销须有实际发票与付款证明。

limitation.en: These are Round 3 requirements, not proof such documents were produced under the cancelled Round 1 project. Request the actual Round 1 file rather than treating the new template as project evidence.
limitation.zh: 这些是第三轮要求，不证明已取消第一轮项目产生了这些材料，应索取实际第一轮档案。

title.en: Prior-project recovery / redesign hypothesis

rationale.en: Keep as a lower-priority redesign or recovery hypothesis. Existing project records create a useful diligence route, but the new vendor inputs make an unsubsidized full new build less attractive than the other four cases.
rationale.zh: 保留为较低优先级的重设计或恢复假设。历史项目资料提供核查路径，但新厂家参数显示，无补贴全新建设弱于其他四处。

anchors.en: The property is documented and Pacific Power offers eligible nonresidential charging-planning assistance. The earlier ODOT corridor agreement was cancelled; nearby DCFC is recorded at 0.2 miles.
anchors.zh: 物业有资料，Pacific Power向符合条件的非住宅客户提供充电规划支持。此前ODOT走廊协议已取消，最近快充记录仅0.2英里。

counter.en: The reason for cancellation, current rights and reusable work are unknown. Nearby competition weakens incremental demand; the vendor utility proxy is higher than in the WA and TX examples.
counter.zh: 取消原因、现有权利及可复用工程待核；近邻竞争削弱增量需求，厂家电费代理值也高于华盛顿州和德州示例。

test.en: Resolve cancellation and asset rights before a new-build bid. Seek an owner-authorized utility assessment and an explicitly scoped restoration quote; separately verify any rebate and measured incremental demand.
test.zh: 新建投标前先查明取消原因和资产权利。取得业主授权的供电评估和明确范围的恢复报价，单独核实返利及实测增量需求。

finding.en: Official store #132 lists 7979 SE Powell Blvd and daily 06:00–23:59.
finding.zh: WinCo #132 官方页确认 7979 SE Powell Blvd，06:00–23:59。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official store detail page and read address/hours.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: No-family-home-charging catchment thesis remains unmeasured.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: PGE EEA DCFC 3 (id 355796), 0.338 straight-line miles, 1 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: Portland, OR - SE Foster Rd, PLAN, 1.746 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 355796，直线 0.338 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 PLAN。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

finding.en: PGE states new reservation and unreserved-application funding is exhausted; no approved reservation is evidenced for this candidate.
finding.zh: PGE 新预留及未预留申请资金耗尽；本址无获批预留凭据。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official rebate page and read Funding availability.
checks.nextEvidence: Approved candidate-specific reservation or an unsubsidized viable cost case.
checks.significance: Use zero unapproved rebate; advertised maximum award is not committed funding.

finding.en: Exact-address municipal search surfaced Portland permit 24-015909-000-00-CO / 5016867, but report timed out and detail page was unavailable. Search-only content is not used to establish scope or absence. No frozen supply match within 0.25 miles is not evidence of no permit.
finding.zh: 市政检索发现许可 24-015909-000-00-CO / 5016867，但报告超时、详情页不可读；不采摘要证明范围或没有充电项目。

checks.verificationMethod: Exact-address web search then original report/detail opens; timeout/cache miss; direct fallback DNS failure.
checks.nextEvidence: Current full parcel permit search and operator/landlord charging agreement.
checks.significance: Nearby PGE fast charging and pipeline already undermine an unqualified gap claim; unmet demand remains unknown.

reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Oregon commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Oregon州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: PGE 85-S separates facility-capacity, peak-demand and TOU energy costs.
claim.zh: PGE85-S分别计算设施容量、峰值需量及分时电量成本。

limitation.en: Supplier, voltage, demand history and interval profile are unresolved; no complete actual bill is claimed.
limitation.zh: 供电商、电压、需量历史与分时曲线未定；不声称已得到实际完整电费。

claim.en: Actual Portland report links 7979 SE Powell to 1S2E08AD 12900 (9.04 acres); permit 24-031317-000-00-CO is Final as of May 6, 2025 for deli/seafood equipment.
claim.zh: 实际波特兰报告把7979SEPowell对应到1S2E08AD12900（9.04英亩）；设备改造许可24-031317-000-00-CO于2025年5月6日为Final。

limitation.en: This interior permit is not an EV permit or spare electrical capacity evidence.
limitation.zh: 室内许可并非充电站许可或电力余量证据。

remainingCritical.en: Executed landlord/tenant parking rights, rent, exclusivity and term.
remainingCritical.zh: 已签业主/租户停车权、租金、独家限制及期限。

remainingCritical.en: Point of delivery, available grid capacity, full tariff, connection quote and date.
remainingCritical.zh: 接入点、电力余量、完整费率、接入报价及日期。

remainingCritical.en: EV-specific engineering, permits, environmental constraints and complete EPC quote.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电站专用工程、许可、环境约束及完整EPC报价。

remainingCritical.en: Measured paid demand, competing utilization and realizable selling prices.
remainingCritical.zh: 实测付费需求、竞争站利用率及可实现售价。

changesToPrior.en: Source-qualified findings added; no site-control, capacity, cost or demand gate is promoted to verified.
changesToPrior.zh: 补充分类证据；不将场地控制、容量、成本或需求门槛提升为已核实。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Pending. The parcel and completed store-alteration permit are better identified. Neither is charger approval; PGE capacity and complete costs remain unresolved.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 待核。地块及已完成商店改造许可更明确，但均非充电许可；PGE容量及完整费用仍待核。

facts.claim: 官方物业名称与邮政地址；营业时间 06:00–00:00 每日

reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.
reason.zh: 沿用的储备物业，本轮未重新打开原始来源核查。场地、电力、报价、需求和合同关键证据仍缺，不进入任一正式榜单。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the North Carolina commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按North Carolina州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger-site lease/easement, exclusivity and enforceable public-access term; ownership disclosure is insufficient.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电场地已签署租约/地役权、排他权及可执行开放期限；业主信息不足以替代合同。

remainingCritical.en: Contracted Tesla equipment/network access and revenue economics for each ownership perspective.

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Texas commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.

zh.type: 零售物业 / 投资尽调

facts.claim: 官方物业名称与邮政地址；营业时间 24小时
来源城市标签 GRESHAM：EV类别 1418 辆、插混 525 辆；城市数不等于物业需求。
项目公开资金已用尽；读取时不接受新预留和未预留申请，不能把新补助计作已获资金。

reason.en: Carried-forward reserve. No new original-source review in round one; key site, grid, cost, demand and contractual evidence remains missing. Not eligible for either qualified list.
reason.zh: 沿用的储备物业，本轮未重新打开原始来源核查。场地、电力、报价、需求和合同关键证据仍缺，不进入任一正式榜单。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Oregon commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Oregon州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: PGE 85-S separates facility-capacity, peak-demand and TOU energy costs.
claim.zh: PGE85-S分别计算设施容量、峰值需量及分时电量成本。

limitation.en: Supplier, voltage, demand history and interval profile are unresolved; no complete actual bill is claimed.
limitation.zh: 供电商、电压、需量历史与分时曲线未定；不声称已得到实际完整电费。

claim.en: PGE lists public Level 2 charging on Gresham corridors including E Powell and SE Francis: $0.12/kWh plus $0.28 on weekdays 5–9 pm.
claim.zh: PGE在Gresham道路包括EPowell、SEFrancis列出公共二级充电：$0.12/kWh，工作日17–21时加$0.28。

limitation.en: A lower-speed alternative, not directly comparable DCFC pricing or observed paid demand.
limitation.zh: 属于低速替代选择，不可直接当作快充定价或实测付费需求。

remainingCritical.en: Executed landlord/tenant parking rights, rent, exclusivity and term.
remainingCritical.zh: 已签业主/租户停车权、租金、独家限制及期限。
