remainingCritical.en: Measured paid demand, competing utilization and realizable selling prices.
remainingCritical.zh: 实测付费需求、竞争站利用率及可实现售价。

changesToPrior.en: Source-qualified findings added; no site-control, capacity, cost or demand gate is promoted to verified.
changesToPrior.zh: 补充分类证据；不将场地控制、容量、成本或需求门槛提升为已核实。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Pending. The street address is corroborated despite a ZIP discrepancy. Nearby Level 2 service and a complex PGE bill do not establish a profitable DCFC opportunity.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 待核。邮编虽有差异，街道地址相互印证；附近慢充服务及复杂PGE账单不能证明快充投资盈利。

checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: Cafaro SOUTH HILL MALL (PUYALLUP, WA) (id 170297), 4.123 straight-line miles, 4 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: [Francis Energy] Tacoma, WA - 1420 E 72nd St, PLAN, 8.139 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: A secondary parcel lead could not be reopened (cache miss, then 403); title, parcel boundary and service territory remain unresolved.
claim.zh: 二级地块线索无法重开（缓存缺失，随后403）；产权、地块及供电范围仍未解决。

limitation.en: Search-preview parcel 602550-0020 is not accepted as verified.
limitation.zh: 不将搜索摘要中的602550-0020视为已核实。

claim.en: PSE Schedule 26 requires over 350 kW; 300 kW and 500 kW scenarios cannot blindly use the same schedule.
claim.zh: PSE26号要求超过350kW；300kW与500kW情景不可盲目使用同一费率。

limitation.en: PSE is itself conditional here; Tacoma/Elmhurst/PSE boundary was not resolved.
limitation.zh: PSE本身在此仍为条件假设；Tacoma/Elmhurst/PSE边界未解决。

remainingCritical.en: Executed landlord/tenant parking rights, rent, exclusivity and term.
remainingCritical.zh: 已签业主/租户停车权、租金、独家限制及期限。

remainingCritical.en: Point of delivery, available grid capacity, full tariff, connection quote and date.
remainingCritical.zh: 接入点、电力余量、完整费率、接入报价及日期。

remainingCritical.en: EV-specific engineering, permits, environmental constraints and complete EPC quote.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电站专用工程、许可、环境约束及完整EPC报价。

remainingCritical.en: Measured paid demand, competing utilization and realizable selling prices.
remainingCritical.zh: 实测付费需求、竞争站利用率及可实现售价。

changesToPrior.en: Source-qualified findings added; no site-control, capacity, cost or demand gate is promoted to verified.
changesToPrior.zh: 补充分类证据；不将场地控制、容量、成本或需求门槛提升为已核实。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Pending. The parcel source could not be reopened, and tariff eligibility changes with load. No ownership or complete bill is asserted.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 待核。地块来源无法重新访问，费率适用随负荷变化；不据此断言产权或完整电费。

attempts.result: Actual web open cache miss and direct HTTP retry 403; search parcel lead not accepted.
Actual relevant source body opened and read.

summary.en: No site-specific paid charging volume or realized-price series found in this bounded public search.
summary.zh: 本轮有限公开检索未找到该场地付费充电量或实收价格序列。

neededDocument.en: 12 months of anonymized paid sessions, delivered kWh, realized net price, downtime and hourly profiles; incremental demand/capture study for the proposed site.
neededDocument.zh: 12个月匿名付费订单、输出电量、实际净售价、停机及逐小时分布；拟建场地的增量需求与客户分流研究。

provider.en: WinCo/property host and nearby charging operators
provider.zh: WinCo/物业方及附近充电运营商

route.en: With owner/operator permission, request anonymized 12-month paid transaction and downtime export; if no installed station, commission a bounded local observation and competing-station demand study. No outreach performed.
route.zh: 经业主/运营商许可索取12个月匿名交易及停机数据；尚未安装充电站时，开展有明确范围的现场观察及竞争站需求研究。本轮未对外联系。

summary.en: Published tariff and/or engineering process is available; no scoped complete charger-project cost or binding quote found.
summary.zh: 可获得公开费率及/或工程流程；未找到有明确范围的完整充电项目成本或约束性报价。

neededDocument.en: Current itemized EPC quotation plus utility connection quote, rent/lease and commercial terms, software/payment/O&M/insurance/tax/replacement costs; inclusions, exclusions, contingency and validity.
neededDocument.zh: 当前分项EPC报价、供电接入报价、租金/租约及商业条款、软件/支付/运维/保险/税费/更换成本；含范围、排除项、预备金和有效期。

provider.en: PSE Customer Construction Services (parcel meter assignment still to confirm); property host and licensed EV EPC
provider.zh: PSE 客户施工服务部门（地块电表归属待确认）；物业方及有资质EV工程总包

route.en: Obtain utility design/quote first; request matching-scope EPC and 10-year operating quotations. Store remodeling valuations and conditional incentives are excluded from confirmed cost.
route.zh: 先取得公用事业设计及报价，再索取相同范围EPC与十年运营报价。商店改造申报价值及未获批补贴不列为已确认成本。

summary.en: A documented utility inquiry/design route is available; parcel spare capacity, connection price and energization date remain unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 已有明确公用事业询问/设计路径；场地剩余容量、接电价格及送电日期仍未确认。

neededDocument.en: Written utility point-of-delivery and firm capacity assessment, load/interval assumptions, all applicable tariffs/riders/taxes, connection scope and cost, energization schedule and reservations.
neededDocument.zh: 公用事业书面接入点及确定可供容量评估、负荷/分时假设、全部费率/附加项/税费、接入工程范围及成本、送电排期与容量保留。

provider.en: PSE Customer Construction Services (parcel meter assignment still to confirm)
provider.zh: PSE 客户施工服务部门（地块电表归属待确认）

route.en: Customer Construction Services inquiry with charger number/type and proposed load; provide owner authorization, meter and site plan for capacity review.
route.zh: 向Customer Construction Services提供桩数、类型及负荷，附业主授权、电表及场地图，申请容量核查。

priorityReason.en: Public utility process provides a follow-up route but no distinctive local demand/cost evidence yet.
priorityReason.zh: 公开供电流程提供跟进路径，但尚无突出的当地需求/成本证据。

claim.en: PSE directs DCFC capacity review to Customer Construction Services with charger count and type.
claim.zh: PSE要求携桩数和类型由Customer Construction Services开展DCFC容量核查。

limitation.en: No completed capacity review, quote or energization commitment for this address.
limitation.zh: 该地址未取得完整容量核查、报价或送电承诺。

attempts.result: Search returned facility registration and retail lists; these do not establish charging demand or EV construction cost.
attempts.method: fresh web search; unrelated matches excluded

attempts.query: Official utility EV/new-service availability and cost acquisition route
attempts.result: Original relevant page body opened and read; no candidate-specific engineering commitment disclosed.
attempts.method: original-source read

selectionReason.en: Public utility process provides a follow-up route but no distinctive local demand/cost evidence yet.
selectionReason.zh: 公开供电流程提供跟进路径，但尚无突出的当地需求/成本证据。

decisionChange.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
decisionChange.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

title.en: New-build / four-post staged hypothesis
title.zh: 本地新增 / 四枪分期假设

rationale.en: First investigate a four-post retail site: 24-hour amenities and a larger nearby supply gap than the other urban WinCo options reviewed. This is an investigation priority, not a forecast of market share.
rationale.zh: 优先调查四枪零售站：全天配套，本轮城市WinCo候选中近邻供给间距相对较大。这是调查优先级，不是市场份额预测。

anchors.en: Official store identity/hours were reconfirmed. The retained October 29 supply snapshot has no DCFC record within 3 straight-line miles and a nearest record at 4.1 miles. County traffic records cover the 176th Street corridor, but no exact count/year/location join was verified.
anchors.zh: 重核官方门店身份及营业时间。10月29日供给快照中，直线3英里内没有快充记录，最近记录4.1英里。县交通资料覆盖176街，但未核定精确计数、年份与位置的对应。

counter.en: Home charging can dominate suburban demand. Road traffic, city EV registrations and a database gap do not establish paid charging demand. Utility territory, capacity and parking rights remain unverified.
counter.zh: 郊区可能主要在家充电。道路车流、城市EV注册量及数据库空白均不证明付费需求；供电区域、容量和停车权利待核。

test.en: Match road counters to actual entrances; inspect turning access and nearby South Hill charging queues. Obtain comparable paid energy across seasons, then test incremental capture, complete four-post EPC cost and a written utility service offer.
test.zh: 把交通计数点匹配实际出入口，检查转向通行及South Hill竞品排队。取得跨季节可比付费电量，再核增量捕获、四枪完整EPC费用及书面接电方案。

estimate.kind: vendor projection; not measured paid demand

design.en: Four-post new-build comparison; upgrade savings are not assumed.
design.zh: 四枪全新建设比较；未假定改造可节省成本。

finding.en: Official store #28 lists 1500 SW Oak St and 24-hour store operation.
finding.zh: WinCo #28 官方页确认 1500 SW Oak St 及全天营业。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official store detail page and read address/hours.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: Nearby dealer/civic chargers require incremental-demand evidence.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: Tonkin Hillsboro CJDR (id 316315), 0.245 straight-line miles, 2 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: Hillsboro, OR - NE Cornell Rd, PLAN, 6.384 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 316315，直线 0.245 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 PLAN。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

finding.en: PGE states new reservation and unreserved-application funding is exhausted; no approved reservation is evidenced for this candidate.
finding.zh: PGE 新预留及未预留申请资金耗尽；本址无获批预留凭据。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official rebate page and read Funding availability.
checks.nextEvidence: Approved candidate-specific reservation or an unsubsidized viable cost case.
checks.significance: Use zero unapproved rebate; advertised maximum award is not committed funding.

reason.en: Required land-control, utility, engineering quote and demand evidence remain missing; investment payback not proven.
reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

attemptedSources.result: Read relevant primary text this round

attemptedSources.method: Opened official rebate page and read Funding availability.
attemptedSources.result: verified

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Oregon commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Oregon州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

reason.en: Qualification unchanged: pending. No complete site-level demand, cost and connection package was obtained; shared stress inputs are retained rather than replaced by unsupported estimates.
reason.zh: 资格不变：仍待核。尚未取得完整的场地订单、成本和接电资料；保留共用压力输入，不以无依据估算替换。

claim.en: PGE 85-S separates facility-capacity, peak-demand and TOU energy costs.
claim.zh: PGE85-S分别计算设施容量、峰值需量及分时电量成本。

limitation.en: Supplier, voltage, demand history and interval profile are unresolved; no complete actual bill is claimed.

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Oregon commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Oregon州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.

description.en: Both lenses require verified site rights, utility/cost/tariff, demand, permits/access and commercial terms. Base payback must be at most 6 years and conservative at most 8 years from first spend; base NPV at 10% real must be nonnegative across 10 operating years after construction, and conservative cash after replacement allowance positive. These are chosen underwriting rules, not industry standards or Tesla criteria. No target count can override them.
description.zh: 两个视角均须核实场地权利、电力/报价/费率、需求、许可/开放和商业条款。首笔支出起，基准回本≤6年、保守≤8年；建设后10个运营年按10%实际折现率计算的基准NPV≥0，保守情景扣更新预留后现金为正。这是明确选定的投资规则，不是行业标准或Tesla标准；不得为凑数放宽。

conclusion.en: Zero investment-ready projects in this selected pool does not establish that U.S. charging sites are unbuildable or unprofitable. Missing project evidence and failure of a shared stress case are different findings.
conclusion.zh: 本候选池零个项目达到投资条件，不代表美国充电场地不能建设或不能盈利。项目证据不足与共用压力情景失败，是两种不同结论。

greenfieldRule.en: A new station cannot provide its own pre-opening sales. Validate a forecast with comparable paid-session records, local demand/access/competition and explicit capture, diversion and downside assumptions. Existing-asset expansions also need incremental-demand evidence.
greenfieldRule.zh: 新站不可能提供开业前自身订单。须用可比站付费记录、本地需求、进出条件与竞争，验证获客、分流及下行情景预测；既有站扩建还须验证新增需求。

coverage.en: Round four follows up the ten previously selected evidence priorities; the other 27 retain round-three records. Operational comparisons stay outside the candidate count. No outreach, paid studies or utility applications were performed.
coverage.zh: 第四轮继续追查此前选定10处，其余27处沿用第三轮记录。运营对照不计入候选数量。未对外联系、付费研究或提交接电申请。

summary.en: Eneridge reports three completed California sites, each with two battery-buffered 150 kW chargers: 7,605 sessions across all six chargers over 365 days, and $1,363,492 total project cost including a $1,000,000 grant. These are project totals, not per-site paid sales or quotes.

limitation.en: Contractor report hosted by CEC, not an independent CEC audit. Reported uptime is 78.40–88.86%; the charger manufacturer went bankrupt in 2024. claim.en: The 2026–2028 Make Ready criteria cap normal program investment at $300,000 per project. Public-facing retail is eligible in principle; at least one DC fast charger is required. Georgia Power owns behind-meter infrastructure; the customer may owe costs above the cap. Future-proofing is excluded.
claim.zh: 2026–2028年Make Ready通常每项目上限30万美元，公共零售场地原则上可申请，至少一台DC快充；表后基础设施由Georgia Power持有，超额可由客户承担，未来预埋扩容不予资助。

limitation.en: The cap is not a WinCo/Sprouts award or quote. Utility criteria and signed project scope control; do not subtract $300,000 from existing capex.
limitation.zh: 该上限不是本场地获批金额或报价，不得从现有建设成本直接减去30万美元。

claim.en: Program terms require property authority and acceptance, with separate funding confirmation. The current page schedules funding through December 31, 2028 or budget exhaustion; site assessment and approved design precede equipment orders.
claim.zh: 项目条款要求物业授权及审批，并另行确认资金；现行页面有效期至2028年12月31日或资金用尽，现场评估和批准设计先于设备订购。

limitation.en: An older general FAQ still says 2022; current 2026–2028 criteria and current program page supersede that stale date. No signed acceptance, site visit or capacity result obtained.
limitation.zh: 旧FAQ仍写2022年，应以现行2026–2028标准及项目页为准。未取得签署接受文件、现场评估或容量结果。

claim.en: CIEV-1 applies on request to a dedicated EV meter under PL tariffs, excluding RTP. Billing-demand factors are 0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80 for bills 1–12/13–24/25–36/37–48, ending sooner when rolling 12-month load factor reaches 15%.
claim.zh: CIEV-1须申请，适用PL费率下独立EV电表，不适用RTP；第1至4年计费需量系数为0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80，滚动12个月负荷率达到15%则提前结束。

limitation.en: This is temporary bill relief, not an energy price or firm capacity. Existing-account history, rate class and new-meter eligibility are unknown; no model deduction made.
limitation.zh: 这是临时需量账单优惠，不是电价或确定容量；现有账户历史、费率和新电表资格未知，未在模型抵减。

demand.en: Public sources disclose program rules and historic configuration, not the operator transaction export, current accepted EPC budget or new utility service agreement. claim.en: Round 3 offers $2,333,835 on I-5 for at least four stations. It reimburses up to 80% of eligible cost with at least 20% match. Real-estate purchase, major off-site grid upgrades and most variable operating costs are excluded.
claim.zh: 第三轮为I-5至少4站提供2,333,835美元资金，最多报销合格成本80%，需至少20%配套；不含购地、重大场外电网扩容及大部分可变运营费用。

limitation.en: This is a competitive corridor envelope, not per-site construction cost, award, approval or available cash for WinCo. No subsidy is included in the model.
limitation.zh: 这是竞争性走廊预算，并非每址建设成本、获批或WinCo可用现金，模型未计补贴。

claim.en: The current scope template calls for final design, third-party contracts, signed utility-work agreement, final utility plans and a commissioning report with proof of energization; reimbursement requires actual invoices and payment proof.

limitation.en: These are Round 3 requirements, not proof such documents were produced under the cancelled Round 1 project. Request the actual Round 1 file rather than treating the new template as project evidence.
limitation.zh: 这些是第三轮要求，不证明已取消第一轮项目产生了这些材料，应索取实际第一轮档案。

title.en: Machias: new capital and electricity support
title.zh: Machias：新一期资本与电费支持

claim.en: Machias is explicitly listed as an eligible town for Phase 12, due April 30,2027. Capital reimbursement is 100% of eligible costs, capped $300 k/port and $600 k/site, net other grants/expected federal credits. Separately metered electricity is reimbursed 100/80/60/40/20% in years 1-5, capped $300 k/site.
claim.zh: Machias明确列入Phase12，2027年4月30日截止。合格资本支出最高报销100%，每端口30万美元、每址60万美元封顶，扣除其他补贴及预计联邦抵免；独立电表电费前五年按100/80/60/40/20%报销，每址累计30万美元封顶。

limitation.en: No award. Host ownership or executed 5-year 24/7 access agreement, surety/LOC and compliant hardware required. Permanent CCS1 and 150 kW/port simultaneous; NACS encouraged. Bid price increases need approval. Greenville is not in eligible town list. Real estate and most operating overhead excluded. OCPP 2.0.1 and OCPI 2.2.1 are required; Tesla compatibility is unverified. Award is limited by the bid and paid eligible cost. Five-year program access is not proof of a lease covering our full investment horizon.
limitation.zh: 尚无授奖。须有产权或签署五年全天开放协议、保函/信用证及合规设备；每端口永久CCS1及同时150kW，鼓励NACS。提价须批准；Greenville不在名单。房地产及大多数运营管理费用不报销。 还须OCPP2.0.1及OCPI2.2.1，未确认Tesla兼容。授奖受投标金额及实际已付合格成本限制，项目五年开放要求不等于已取得覆盖投资期限的租约。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.

claim.zh: 公司税收抵免上限为2.5万美元或设备购置安装费孰低；每纳税人每税年仅一个直流快充抵免，不能按八个端口倍增。安装窗口为2024年5月15日至2030年1月1日前，须一年内申请。

title.zh: NEVI私人合作及初期运维支持

claim.en: Federal share is 80% of eligible NEVI costs; private/state funds can supply match. States may contract private acquisition, installation and up to 5 years eligible operations/maintenance. Ownership need not revert to the state, subject to contract.
claim.zh: NEVI联邦份额为合格成本80%，私人或州资金可配套；州可委托私人购建并支持最长五年合格运维。按合同资产不必归还州政府。

limitation.en: Not 80% of every budget item and not automaticcash. Requires active state procurement, geography, compliant design, award and reimbursement evidence. Combined eligible federal-highway funding cannot exceed 80%; match and tax/grant interactions must be checked.
limitation.zh: 不是所有预算项自动补80%，更不是已经到账。须满足州招标、地域、设计、授奖与报销条件；合并联邦公路资金仍不能超80%，配套和税收叠加另核。

claim.zh: FHWA2026年3月12日N4510.913通知重新分配了5.03756亿美元州级未承诺NEVI余额，这部分已不能用于NEVI。

limitation.en: This does not cancel all NEVI or establish each state remaining balance. Use current procurement/award amounts instead of historical 2022-26 allocations.

title.en: 30C is not available to a newly built October 2026 charging asset
title.zh: 30C新投运资格已截止

claim.en: IRS limits relevant 30C business property to in-service dates through June 30,2026; a new October 2026+installation cannot claim it.
claim.zh: IRS规定相关30C商业设施最晚须2026年6月30日投运；2026年10月以后新建投运不能享受。

limitation.en: Historic 6%/30% rates and $100 k/item caps are not new-project funding. Previously credited assets have basis/recapture rules; existing-site history does not qualify a new expansion.
limitation.zh: 历史6%/30%及每项10万美元上限不是新项目资金；已抵免资产有计税基础和追回规则，既有站点历史不自动覆盖新增扩建。

claim.en: Eligible stationary energy storage may qualify for 48E:6% base, potentially 30% with applicable labor conditions. Post 2025 construction also faces prohibited-foreign-entity/material-assistance restrictions under 2026 guidance.
claim.zh: 合格固定式储能可能适用48E：基础6%，满足适用劳工条件可能30%；2025年后开工还需满足2026指引的受限外国实体/物料支持规则。

limitation.en: Not a charging-station-wide credit. Requires separately costed storage, ownership, sourcing, tax-basis and claim review. Do not add an assumed credit to pre-tax NPV or omit battery incremental cost/replacement. No project claim verified.
limitation.zh: 不是整座充电站统一抵免。需单列储能成本、所有权、供应链、计税基础及申报核验；不能把假设抵免塞入税前NPV或漏算电池新增成本/更换。未落实具体项目抵免。

claim.en: IRS Topic 704 confirms 100% special depreciation for qualified property acquired and placed in service after Jan 19,2025.
claim.zh: IRS Topic704确认：2025年1月19日后取得并投运的合格财产可适用100%特别折旧。

limitation.en: Not a 100%cash grant. Asset classification, basis, tax liability/lossrules and later depreciation displacement determine value. Current pre-tax hurdle must remain unchanged; a complete after-tax investor model is separate.
limitation.zh: 不是100%现金补贴。价值取决于资产分类、计税基础、纳税能力、亏损规则及后续折旧减少。现有税前硬门槛不变，完整投资者税后模型应单列。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: WA CFS electricity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州充电电力积分

claim.en: Non-residential equipment owners can register to generate saleable credits for eligible electricity dispensed. New designation contracts from January 1, 2026 must expressly allocate/waive generation rights. This is an additional operating revenue mechanism, not a charger manufacturing credit.
claim.zh: 非住宅充电设备所有人可登记，就符合条件的实际供电产生可出售的积分。2026年1月1日起的新转让合同须明确积分权利分配或放弃。这是额外经营收入机制，不是充电桩制造商的生产补贴。

limitation.en: For Tesla for Business, obtain the equipment ownership, environmental-attribute and revenue-sharing clauses, metered kWh, registered generator and sale/aggregation fees. Do not assign revenue to a landlord merely because its parking lot hosts EVgo/Tesla equipment. Historical market prices are not guaranteed realized proceeds.
limitation.zh: Tesla for Business须取得设备产权、环境权益及收益分配条款、计量电量、登记生成方和销售/聚合费用。仅为EVgo或Tesla提供停车场的地主不能自动取得积分收入；历史价格不是保证收入。

required.en: signed credit ownership/allocation agreement; WFRS/FSE registration; metered eligible kWh; applicable annual CI and EER; sale counterparty/fees
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: WA LMD-FCI unused-capacity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州快充闲置容量积分

claim.en: Unused DCFC capacity can earn a separate five-year credit stream after approval. Applications are due by December 31, 2029. Equipment permitted before January 1, 2023 or required as SEPA mitigation is excluded. Public access, network reporting and commissioning are required. Regular dispensing credits remain distinct.
claim.zh: 获批后，直流快充未利用容量可产生独立的五年积分收入，申请截止2029年12月31日。2023年1月1日前获准运行或属于SEPA强制缓解措施的设备不适用。须满足公众开放、联网报告及投运要求；实际充电积分另计。

limitation.en: No current candidate approval or equipment permit date is verified. Existing equipment cannot become newly eligible solely because the atlas proposes an investment. Expansion requires approval and does not restart an existing five-year term. Determine registered FSE boundaries, nameplate and effective simultaneous power for the actual cabinet/post design: eight nominal 250 kW posts must not be blindly counted as 2,000 kW of simultaneous supply. If approved eligible aggregate nameplate exceeds 1,500 kW, an exception is required; the August 25 table showed 44 larger-site equipment slots and 44 approved. Do not assume an exception, new credit clock or flat unused-capacity revenue at high utilization. For approvals after November 20, 2025, generation is subject to the rule’s cumulative-value condition: prior-quarter estimated capacity-credit value must be below 1.5 times initial capex excluding on-site generation, less external capital/operating/maintenance funding. The five-year clock begins in the approval quarter, not at commissioning. Agency value uses quarterly average prices and 10% annual discount to approval-year dollars; this is not guaranteed cash.
limitation.zh: 未核实本候选的积分批准或设备许可日期。把既有站点列作投资候选不等于获得新设备资格；扩建须批准且不能重启已有五年期限。须按真实电源柜/充电柱设计核实登记FSE边界、铭牌功率及同时供电能力，不能直接把8个标称250kW柱视为2,000kW同时供电。若经认可的合格铭牌合计超过1,500kW，须特批；8月25日表中大站设备名额44个、已批准44个。不能假设有特批、新计期或高利用率仍获满额闲置容量收入。 2025年11月20日后批准的项目受累计价值条件约束：上一季度累计估算容量积分价值须低于初始资本支出（不含场内发电）的1.5倍，再扣外部资本、运营和维护资助。五年从获批季度开始，不是从投运开始。监管估值按季度均价及10%年折现折至获批年度，不是保证现金。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Oregon Clean Fuels Program electricity credits
title.zh: 俄勒冈州充电电力积分

claim.en: Oregon identifies the non-residential charger owner, or the operator if the owner does not register, as the electricity credit participant. Registration, transaction records and quarterly/annual reports are required. Credits are tradeable emissions reductions, creating possible additional operating revenue.
claim.zh: 俄勒冈将非住宅充电桩所有人、或所有人未登记时的运营人列为积分参与方。须登记、留存交易记录及季度/年度报告；可交易减排积分可形成额外经营收入。

limitation.en: Ownership and allocation are not verified for these candidates. Use the annual lifecycle electricity CI and approved pathway, not the direct-emissions table alone. September 2026 agency-reported price does not reconcile to the transaction rows in the downloaded workbook; preserve this discrepancy and do not present it as independently verified cashflow.
limitation.zh: 这些候选的产权与积分分配未核实。须采用年度全生命周期电力碳强度及批准路径，不能只取直接排放表。下载的2026年9月官方价格汇总与其交易明细无法复算一致；保留差异，不能声称已独立验证收入。

required.en: equipment owner/operator registration and contractual rights; OFRS/FSE registration; metered eligible kWh; current lifecycle CI/EER; realized credit sale price/fees
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Pacific Power Oregon business DCFC rebate
title.zh: Pacific Power直流快充返利

claim.en: For approved DCFC equipment at or above 150 kW, Pacific Power offers up to 75% of eligible costs capped at $30,000 per port. The ordinary site maximum is $100,000; larger requests require preapproval. Customer/account, invoices, permits, equipment and funding conditions apply.
claim.zh: Pacific Power对经认可的150kW及以上直流快充最高补贴合格成本75%，每接口上限3万美元。常规每址上限10万美元，更高金额须预批；须满足客户、电表、发票、许可、设备及资金条件。

limitation.en: No Tesla entry was found in the September 22, 2026 approved-product list; StarCharge Titan V4 is a different manufacturer. Treat as an alternate-hardware lead until Tesla V4 eligibility is confirmed in writing. Final itemized invoices rather than estimates are required; apply within one year of equipment purchase. Cannot combine with Pacific Power Fleet Make-Ready at the same site. No Medford award verified.
limitation.zh: 2026年9月22日认可设备表未找到Tesla条目；StarCharge Titan V4不是Tesla。取得Tesla V4书面资格确认前仅作为其他设备方案线索。须提供最终分项发票，购买设备一年内申请；同址不能叠加Pacific Power Fleet Make-Ready。未核实Medford获款。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: PGE DCFC rebate waitlist
title.zh: PGE直流快充返利候补名单

claim.en: PGE lists up to $55,000 per port and $330,000 per site for equipment in eligible underserved communities. Its current page says funding is exhausted and new reservations/unreserved applications cannot be approved; waitlist only.
claim.zh: PGE公布符合条件的弱势社区设备补贴每接口最高5.5万美元、每址33万美元，但当前页面注明资金已用完，不能批准新预留或无预留申请，只能排候补。

limitation.en: Equipment only: installation, warranties and network fees are excluded. Permits no earlier than January 1, 2026; actual PGE account, mapped area and all equipment requirements need confirmation. City/territory screening is not address eligibility. This is zero available/committed cash for current decisions.
limitation.zh: 仅设备购置；安装、质保和网络费不在范围。许可日期须不早于2026年1月1日，并核实PGE电表、区域图和设备要求。城市/辖区初筛不等于地址合格。当前决策可确认资金为零。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Washington EV Charging Program
title.zh: 华盛顿州充电项目：当前无开放轮次

claim.en: Commerce reports Round 1 and Round 2 awards but no open funding opportunities; future funding is subject to the legislative session beginning January 2027.
claim.zh: 商务厅公布首轮及第二轮拨款，但当前无开放申请；后续资金取决于2027年1月开始的立法会期。

limitation.en: Historical award totals and a nearby funded station do not create an award for a new candidate. Do not insert the program maximum into net capex.
limitation.zh: 历史总拨款或邻近站点获款不等于本候选获款，不能将项目最高额直接抵减成本。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Clark annual DCFC account credit
title.zh: Clark年度快充电表抵扣

claim.en: Clark advertises $1,500 per year per DC fast charger on a dedicated meter under Schedule 134; Schedule 434 does not qualify. This is a bill-credit route requiring account and equipment confirmation.
claim.zh: Clark对独立电表、Schedule 134下的直流快充公布每台每年1,500美元抵扣；Schedule 434不适用，须核实电表及设备。

limitation.en: Do not multiply by connector count without the utility confirming its charger definition. The separate EV-GO up-to-50% project program is restricted to Clark County municipal/local-government and nonprofit entities, not automatically a private WinCo/investor grant.
limitation.zh: 没有供电公司确认“充电设备”定义前，不能直接乘以接口数。另一个EV-GO最高50%项目仅面向Clark县市政/地方政府及非营利机构，不自动适用于私营WinCo/投资者。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: WA alternative-fuel infrastructure B&O / PUT tax credit
title.zh: 华盛顿州基础设施B&O/PUT抵免

claim.en: Current law allows up to 50% of qualifying infrastructure, components and installation/construction cost as a B&O or PUT tax credit, excluding property acquisition and site improvement. It is nonrefundable, first-come, capped statewide and may carry only to the following calendar year. DOR October 1, 2026 reported $5,055,084.37 annual and $12,973,918.88 lifetime availability before outstanding applications.
claim.zh: 现行法允许合格基础设施、部件和安装/施工成本最高50%抵扣B&O或PUT税，不含土地购买和场地改良。不可退税、先到先得、受全州额度约束，最多结转至下一历年。DOR截至2026年10月1日公布年度余量5,055,084.37美元、累计余量12,973,918.88美元，未扣待批申请。

limitation.en: DOR describes eligible commercial-vehicle businesses; no candidate-specific taxpayer/infrastructure interpretation, reservation or usable tax liability is verified. Obtain a project eligibility determination and tax-liability schedule before counting. B&O and PUT cannot both claim the same amount. Unused credit beyond the short carry period has no assumed cash value. A 50% headline is not a cash grant. The reported balances cover the combined vehicle/infrastructure program, not a site reservation: $2m annual infrastructure category, $6m combined annual and $32.5m lifetime caps; unused category credits can be reallocated on September 1 under the statute. Confirm category/reallocated availability before applying.
limitation.zh: DOR的资格表述针对商用车业务；未核实本候选纳税主体/设施解释、额度预留或可抵税负。须取得项目资格确认与税负计划后才计入；相同金额不能同时抵B&O和PUT，短期结转后未用额度不得假设有现金价值。50%标题不是现金补助。 上述余额属于车辆及基础设施合并项目，不是场地预留额度：基础设施类别年度200万美元、合并年度600万美元、累计3,250万美元上限；法律允许9月1日重新分配未用类别额度。申请前核实类别/重新分配后的可用额度。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: WA EV infrastructure sales/use tax exemption
title.zh: 华盛顿州已到期销售/使用税豁免

claim.en: The EV infrastructure sales/use and associated leasehold exemption expired July 1, 2025. It is not a new-project tax saving for this October 2026 screen.
claim.zh: 电动车基础设施销售/使用税及相关租赁税豁免已于2025年7月1日到期，不能作为本次2026年10月新项目的减税。

limitation.en: Keep applicable sales/use taxes in complete capex unless a different, independently verified exemption applies. Do not reuse stale incentive directories.
limitation.zh: 完整成本应保留适用销售/使用税，除非另有独立核实的豁免；不能沿用过时补贴目录。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Georgia Power Make Ready (carried from round four)
title.zh: Georgia Power接电建设支持（沿用第四轮）

claim.en: The 2026–2028 Make Ready criteria cap normal program investment at $300,000 per project. Public-facing retail is eligible in principle; at least one DC fast charger is required. Georgia Power owns behind-meter infrastructure; the customer may owe costs above the cap. Future-proofing is excluded. Program terms require property authority and acceptance, with separate funding confirmation. The current page schedules funding through December 31, 2028 or budget exhaustion; site assessment and approved design precede equipment orders.
claim.zh: 2026–2028年Make Ready通常每项目上限30万美元，公共零售场地原则上可申请，至少一台DC快充；表后基础设施由Georgia Power持有，超额可由客户承担，未来预埋扩容不予资助。 项目条款要求物业授权及审批，并另行确认资金；现行页面有效期至2028年12月31日或资金用尽，现场评估和批准设计先于设备订购。

limitation.en: Carried forward from the dated prior review. No current site award or enrollment; program caps are not a rebate against every budget item. Verify award scope and any overlapping funding.
limitation.zh: 沿用有日期的此前核查，无本址授奖或加入证明；项目上限不等于所有预算可抵扣，须核实具体范围及重复资助。

required.en: Owner authority, approved equipment/design, accepted application and written funding amount/tariff enrollment.
required.zh: 业主授权、设备/设计获批、申请受理及书面资助金额/费率加入证明。

title.en: Georgia Power CIEV demand adjustment (carried from round four)
title.zh: Georgia Power CIEV需量调整（沿用第四轮）

claim.en: CIEV-1 applies on request to a dedicated EV meter under PL tariffs, excluding RTP. Billing-demand factors are 0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80 for bills 1–12/13–24/25–36/37–48, ending sooner when rolling 12-month load factor reaches 15%.
claim.zh: CIEV-1须申请，适用PL费率下独立EV电表，不适用RTP；第1至4年计费需量系数为0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80，滚动12个月负荷率达到15%则提前结束。

limitation.en: Carried forward from the dated prior review. No current site award or enrollment; program caps are not a rebate against every budget item. Verify award scope and any overlapping funding.
limitation.zh: 沿用有日期的此前核查，无本址授奖或加入证明；项目上限不等于所有预算可抵扣，须核实具体范围及重复资助。

required.en: Owner authority, approved equipment/design, accepted application and written funding amount/tariff enrollment.
required.zh: 业主授权、设备/设计获批、申请受理及书面资助金额/费率加入证明。

title.en: ODOT Round 3 I-5 route (carried from round four)
title.zh: ODOT第三轮I-5路径（沿用第四轮）

claim.en: Round 3 offers $2,333,835 on I-5 for at least four stations. It reimburses up to 80% of eligible cost with at least 20% match. Real-estate purchase, major off-site grid upgrades and most variable operating costs are excluded. The current scope template calls for final design, third-party contracts, signed utility-work agreement, final utility plans and a commissioning report with proof of energization; reimbursement requires actual invoices and payment proof.
claim.zh: 第三轮为I-5至少4站提供2,333,835美元资金，最多报销合格成本80%，需至少20%配套；不含购地、重大场外电网扩容及大部分可变运营费用。 现行范围模板要求最终设计、第三方合同、签署的供电工程协议、最终公用事业图纸，以及含送电证明的调试报告；报销须有实际发票与付款证明。

limitation.en: Carried forward from the dated prior review. No current site award or enrollment; program caps are not a rebate against every budget item. Verify award scope and any overlapping funding.
limitation.zh: 沿用有日期的此前核查，无本址授奖或加入证明；项目上限不等于所有预算可抵扣，须核实具体范围及重复资助。

required.en: Owner authority, approved equipment/design, accepted application and written funding amount/tariff enrollment.
required.zh: 业主授权、设备/设计获批、申请受理及书面资助金额/费率加入证明。

title.en: Tesla-owned charging network
title.zh: Tesla自营充电网络

description.en: Charging receipts accrue to the charging operator; host terms are separately negotiated. Tesla bears project/operating costs under its own scope; public reseller equipment prices do not disclose its internal costs.
description.zh: 充电收入归充电运营主体，地主条款另行协商。 Tesla按自身范围承担建设运营成本，第三方设备售价不披露其内部成本。

limitation.en: Keep the same investment gates, but do not label third-party illustrative P&L as Tesla’s return.
limitation.zh: 保留同样投资门槛，但不得将第三方示例损益当作Tesla回报。

title.en: Third-party ownership / Tesla service
title.zh: 第三方持有／Tesla运营服务

description.en: Owner sets charging prices and receives remittances less contractual fees; other rights require contract confirmation. Owner buys hardware, contracts installation and pays electricity/site costs. Reconcile equipment service, card/internet fees already included.
description.zh: 业主设定充电价并收取扣合同费用后的结算，其他权益须合同确认。 业主购买设备、委托安装并支付电费及场地成本；核对已含设备服务、刷卡及网络费用。

limitation.en: The existing owner cash-flow framework fits this question, but regional stress inputs are not parcel forecasts.
limitation.zh: 现有业主现金流框架适合此问题，但州级压力输入不是逐址预测。

title.en: Property host / landlord
title.zh: 纯场地提供方／地主

description.en: Negotiated rent or evidenced incremental merchant margin; no automatic ownership of charging receipts or credits. Host obligations and parking opportunity cost are contractual; do not impose an entire charger capex by default.
description.zh: 协商租金或经核实的新增商户毛利，不自动拥有充电收入或积分。 地主责任及停车位机会成本由合同确定，不默认承担整站充电资本支出。

limitation.en: Separate host economics cannot rescue the charging investor’s failed hurdle. No host contract obtained.
limitation.zh: 地主单独收益不能替充电投资方通过门槛，目前未取得地主合同。

title.en: WA LMD-FCI unused-capacity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州快充闲置容量积分

claim.en: Unused DCFC capacity can earn a separate five-year credit stream after approval. Applications are due by December 31, 2029. Equipment permitted before January 1, 2023 or required as SEPA mitigation is excluded. Public access, network reporting and commissioning are required. Regular dispensing credits remain distinct.
claim.zh: 获批后，直流快充未利用容量可产生独立的五年积分收入，申请截止2029年12月31日。2023年1月1日前获准运行或属于SEPA强制缓解措施的设备不适用。须满足公众开放、联网报告及投运要求；实际充电积分另计。

limitation.en: No current candidate approval or equipment permit date is verified. Existing equipment cannot become newly eligible solely because the atlas proposes an investment. Expansion requires approval and does not restart an existing five-year term. Determine registered FSE boundaries, nameplate and effective simultaneous power for the actual cabinet/post design: eight nominal 250 kW posts must not be blindly counted as 2,000 kW of simultaneous supply. If approved eligible aggregate nameplate exceeds 1,500 kW, an exception is required; the August 25 table showed 44 larger-site equipment slots and 44 approved. Do not assume an exception, new credit clock or flat unused-capacity revenue at high utilization. For approvals after November 20, 2025, generation is subject to the rule’s cumulative-value condition: prior-quarter estimated capacity-credit value must be below 1.5 times initial capex excluding on-site generation, less external capital/operating/maintenance funding. The five-year clock begins in the approval quarter, not at commissioning. Agency value uses quarterly average prices and 10% annual discount to approval-year dollars; this is not guaranteed cash.
limitation.zh: 未核实本候选的积分批准或设备许可日期。把既有站点列作投资候选不等于获得新设备资格；扩建须批准且不能重启已有五年期限。须按真实电源柜/充电柱设计核实登记FSE边界、铭牌功率及同时供电能力，不能直接把8个标称250kW柱视为2,000kW同时供电。若经认可的合格铭牌合计超过1,500kW，须特批；8月25日表中大站设备名额44个、已批准44个。不能假设有特批、新计期或高利用率仍获满额闲置容量收入。 2025年11月20日后批准的项目受累计价值条件约束：上一季度累计估算容量积分价值须低于初始资本支出（不含场内发电）的1.5倍，再扣外部资本、运营和维护资助。五年从获批季度开始，不是从投运开始。监管估值按季度均价及10%年折现折至获批年度，不是保证现金。

title.en: WA CFS electricity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州充电电力积分

claim.en: Non-residential equipment owners can register to generate saleable credits for eligible electricity dispensed. New designation contracts from January 1, 2026 must expressly allocate/waive generation rights. This is an additional operating revenue mechanism, not a charger manufacturing credit.
claim.zh: 非住宅充电设备所有人可登记，就符合条件的实际供电产生可出售的积分。2026年1月1日起的新转让合同须明确积分权利分配或放弃。这是额外经营收入机制，不是充电桩制造商的生产补贴。

limitation.en: For Tesla for Business, obtain the equipment ownership, environmental-attribute and revenue-sharing clauses, metered kWh, registered generator and sale/aggregation fees. Do not assign revenue to a landlord merely because its parking lot hosts EVgo/Tesla equipment. Historical market prices are not guaranteed realized proceeds.
limitation.zh: Tesla for Business须取得设备产权、环境权益及收益分配条款、计量电量、登记生成方和销售/聚合费用。仅为EVgo或Tesla提供停车场的地主不能自动取得积分收入；历史价格不是保证收入。

title.en: Machias: new capital and electricity support
title.zh: Machias：新一期资本与电费支持

claim.en: Machias is explicitly listed as an eligible town for Phase 12, due April 30,2027. Capital reimbursement is 100% of eligible costs, capped $300 k/port and $600 k/site, net other grants/expected federal credits. Separately metered electricity is reimbursed 100/80/60/40/20% in years 1-5, capped $300 k/site.
claim.zh: Machias明确列入Phase12，2027年4月30日截止。合格资本支出最高报销100%，每端口30万美元、每址60万美元封顶，扣除其他补贴及预计联邦抵免；独立电表电费前五年按100/80/60/40/20%报销，每址累计30万美元封顶。

limitation.en: No award. Host ownership or executed 5-year 24/7 access agreement, surety/LOC and compliant hardware required. Permanent CCS1 and 150 kW/port simultaneous; NACS encouraged. Bid price increases need approval. Greenville is not in eligible town list. Real estate and most operating overhead excluded. OCPP 2.0.1 and OCPI 2.2.1 are required; Tesla compatibility is unverified. Award is limited by the bid and paid eligible cost. Five-year program access is not proof of a lease covering our full investment horizon.
limitation.zh: 尚无授奖。须有产权或签署五年全天开放协议、保函/信用证及合规设备；每端口永久CCS1及同时150kW，鼓励NACS。提价须批准；Greenville不在名单。房地产及大多数运营管理费用不报销。 还须OCPP2.0.1及OCPI2.2.1，未确认Tesla兼容。授奖受投标金额及实际已付合格成本限制，项目五年开放要求不等于已取得覆盖投资期限的租约。

title.en: Network utilization is not a local forecast
title.zh: 网络利用量不是本址预测

claim.en: Tesla reports more than 10 U.S. sessions per stall per day. Our 2/4/8 cases are therefore stress assumptions, not a Tesla population forecast.
claim.zh: Tesla自述美国平均每枪每天超过10次；现有2/4/8次应视为压力假设，不能当作Tesla总体预测。

limitation.en: No sample period, distribution or candidate capture is disclosed. Do not assign the network mean to a new site.
limitation.zh: 未披露样本期间、分布或候选址可获取需求，不能直接套用网络均值。

title.en: Separate owner and operator responsibilities
title.zh: 区分业主与运营商责任

claim.en: Tesla assigns installation and ordinary site cleanup to the owner; equipment service, software and network operations are Tesla responsibilities.
claim.zh: Tesla将安装及普通场地清洁分配给业主，设备服务、软件及网络运营由Tesla负责。

limitation.en: Specific pricing, exclusions, guarantees and remedies require the executed agreement. The generic model cannot establish Tesla internal costs.
limitation.zh: 具体价格、排除项、保证及补救须看执行合同；通用模型不代表Tesla内部成本。

title.en: Four posts are a real product option
title.zh: 四枪是实际产品选项

claim.en: The current product page permits a minimum four-post purchase and asks the owner to hire an installer.
claim.zh: 当前产品页允许最低购买4枪，并要求业主自行聘请安装方。

limitation.en: A four-post project needs its own electrical/civil scope. Public equipment pricing does not guarantee proportional utility or land costs.
limitation.zh: 四枪项目须独立电气/土建设计，公开设备定价不保证接电及土地成本按比例下降。

title.en: A vendor estimate is not an approved project
title.zh: 厂家估算不是获批项目

claim.en: At the Edmonds research address, the estimator showed 8 posts: $500,000 hardware plus $55,000 installation/post, $940,000 total and indicative 5-year payback. Selecting 4 posts showed $250,000 hardware and $470,000 total.
claim.zh: 对Edmonds研究地址，配置器显示8枪设备50万美元、每枪安装5.5万美元、合计94万美元，示例回本5年；实际切换4枪显示设备25万美元、合计47万美元。

limitation.en: Nonbinding estimate, not a scoped quote, site approval or our underwriting result. Hardware tax is excluded; installation tier was the default Medium.
limitation.zh: 均为非约束估算，不是完整报价、场地批准或本项目门槛结论；不含设备税，安装档位为默认Medium。

title.en: Why Tesla’s five-year illustration differs
title.zh: Tesla五年示例为何不同

claim.en: Edmonds defaults were $0.10/kWh utility cost, $0.49 selling price and 298 kWh/post/day. The disclaimer assumes 7% annual utilization growth, about 15% grid-to-battery loss and no parking rent.
claim.zh: Edmonds默认购电0.10美元/度、售价0.49美元/度、每枪每天298度；免责声明假设利用率年增7%、电网到电池约15%损耗，并且没有停车位租金。

limitation.en: Utility tooltip includes demand charges and uses fleet-utilization context; it is not a local tariff quote.15-year vendor revenue/payback cannot be directly compared with our flat-real-demand 10-year NPV. Energy boundary requires reconciliation.
limitation.zh: 购电提示说明含需量费并参考车队利用率，不是本址费率报价；厂家15年收入/回本不可直接与固定实际需求的10年NPV比较，电量边界仍须统一。

title.en: Do not pay twice for included service
title.zh: 已包含服务不能重复计费

claim.en: The fee modal includes a 10+year equipment parts/labor service agreement,97% uptime guarantee, card processing, internet and network services within the stated $0.10/kWh package.
claim.zh: 0.10美元/度服务费弹窗列明10年以上设备零件/人工服务协议、97%可用率保证、刷卡处理、网络连接及运营服务。

limitation.en: Avoid duplicating included costs. Our extra full-capex-based replacement allowance has no itemized uncovered-asset basis; this is an unresolved scope risk, not proof every reserve dollar is double counted.
limitation.zh: 应避免重复计入已覆盖费用。当前按总资本比例计提额外更换预留缺少未覆盖资产明细，属于范围待核，不能据此断定全部重复计费。

title.en: Operating contribution differs from net profit
title.zh: 经营贡献不等于净利润

claim.en: EVgo Q2 2026 reports $61.421 m charging-network revenue and $39.247 m network cost of sales; depreciation is separate. Consolidated net loss was $46.342 m.
claim.zh: EVgo2026年第二季度充电网络收入6142.1万美元、网络销售成本3924.7万美元，折旧另列；合并净亏损4634.2万美元。

limitation.en: The $22.174 m difference is before separate depreciation/corporate costs, not net profit or candidate economics. Positive operating contribution and company losses can coexist.
limitation.zh: 两者差额2217.4万美元尚未扣单列折旧及公司费用，不是净利润或候选址经济性；经营贡献为正可与公司亏损并存。

title.en: Commercial cofunding exists
title.zh: 存在商业共同出资

claim.en: EVgo reported $6.522 m Q2 capital offsets: $1.352 m OEM infrastructure payments and $5.170 m capital-build funding, against $33.823 m gross capital expenditure. Public-network throughput was 276 kWh/stall/day.
claim.zh: EVgo披露第二季度资本抵补652.2万美元，其中车企基础设施付款135.2万美元、建设资金517万美元，对应总资本支出3382.3万美元；公共网络每枪每天276度。

limitation.en: Commercial cofunding is a real additional mechanism, not an available award for these sites. The 276 benchmark covers EVgo-owned public stalls, not all 5,380 ending stalls or Tesla utilization.
limitation.zh: 商业共同出资是实际存在的额外机制，不是这些场地已可取得的资助；276度对应EVgo自营公共枪位，不是全部5380个期末枪位或Tesla利用率。

title.en: Tesla’s mixed segment cannot prove station returns
title.zh: Tesla混合业务不能证明单站收益

claim.en: Tesla Q3 2026 services-and-other revenue was $4.605 bn against $3.871 bn costs. The filing associates growth with used vehicles, repairs and paid Supercharging.
claim.zh: Tesla2026年第三季度服务及其他收入46.05亿美元、成本38.71亿美元；文件将增长关联至二手车、维修和付费超充。

limitation.en: This mixed category does not disclose standalone Supercharging profit, each site’s returns or Tesla’s internal cost of capital.
limitation.zh: 该混合类别未披露独立超充利润、逐站回报或Tesla内部资本成本。

title.en: Credit rights follow the contract
title.zh: 积分权益取决于合同

claim.en: Los Gatos’s attached historical agreement allocates construction, utility and charger-maintenance costs to Tesla; the host cannot collect charging fees. Its proposed 2021 amendment assigns incentives to Tesla and specifies rent.
claim.zh: Los Gatos所附历史协议由Tesla承担施工、电费及设备维护，地主不能收充电费；2021年拟议修订将激励权益归Tesla并约定租金。

limitation.en: A dated contract example, not current standard terms: the amendment is unsigned in the packet and does not prove execution or current payment. Credit ownership must be checked before booking incentives.
limitation.zh: 这是有日期的合同示例，非当前标准条款；附件修订未签字，不证明已执行或当前实付。计入补贴前须核实权益归属。

sensitivityExplanation.en: Separate conditional sensitivities preserve the original gross costs and hard gates. Support is never booked as an actual award. Zero/30%/80% gross-capex cases are mathematical ceilings, not eligible-cost determinations. Payback is lasting cumulative recovery within the modeled horizon: temporary recovery followed by later losses does not count. Temporary Machias support expires and is capped; no other aid is stacked. The Machias illustration retains the old eight-post Tesla/state-electricity proxy; it is not a costed grant-compliant design. No observed site return has changed.
sensitivityExplanation.zh: 独立条件敏感性保留原始总成本及硬门槛，绝不把支持当作实际授奖。0/30%/80%总投资比例仅为数学上限，不是合格成本认定。回本指模型期内此后不再转负的累计回收，临时回收后又亏回去不算。Machias临时支持受期限与总额限制，不叠加其他支持。 Machias示例沿用旧八枪Tesla及州电价代理值，并非已报价的补贴合规设计，真实站点回报没有据此得到验证。

method.en: These are vendor-anchored working hypotheses, not calibrated forecasts. Demand factors 0.7/1/1.2, capital factors 1.35/1.2/1.1, utility factors 1.25/1/1 and monthly non-utility costs $2,000/$1,000/$500 were fixed before outcomes. Construction is 1.5/1/0.75 years; first-year ramp 50/75/100%; replacement 2/1.5/1% of gross capex. All cases use four posts, flat real demand, no grant, 10 operating years and the unchanged 6/8-year and 10% NPV gates. These joint stresses have no assigned probability.
method.zh: 这些是由厂家参数出发的工作假设，不是校准预测。需求系数0.7/1/1.2、资本系数1.35/1.2/1.1、电价系数1.25/1/1及每月非电费成本2,000/1,000/500美元均在查看结果前固定。建设期1.5/1/0.75年，首年爬坡50/75/100%，更新预留为总资本2/1.5/1%。均为四枪、实际需求不增长、不计补贴、运营10年，沿用6/8年回本及10%净现值门槛。组合压力情景没有赋予概率。

boundary.en: The 15% loss input is a working grid-to-billed-energy assumption borrowed from Tesla’s different grid-to-battery disclosure. Displayed prices are not verified net receipts. The $470k medium-install illustration excludes hardware tax and does not establish complete utility, civil, land or financing scope. Contingencies, fixed costs and gross-asset reserves are unquoted; reconcile uncovered costs with the $0.10/kWh service package. No inferred savings or credits are admitted. The 35 kWh/session value only converts energy units; it is not a local session forecast.
boundary.zh: 15%损耗是借用Tesla电网至电池披露的电网至计费电量假设，两者计量边界不同。显示售价不是已核净收入。47万美元中档安装示例不含硬件税，也未证明完整接电、土建、土地或融资范围。预备费、固定成本及资产更新预留未获报价，须与每kWh 0.10美元服务包核对未覆盖项目。未计入推定节省或积分。 每次35 kWh仅作电量单位换算，不是本地会话预测。

text.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh per public-network stall per day in Q2 2026, versus 281 in Q2 2025. This observed network aggregate supports testing a higher-energy range, but has different geography, equipment, maturity and pricing. It is not a matched local analogue, a demand ceiling or evidence that utilization always rises.
text.zh: EVgo披露2026年第二季度公共网络平均每枪每日276 kWh，上年同期281。该运营汇总支持研究更高电量区间，但地区、设备、成熟度及价格不同，不是匹配本地的可比站、需求上限，也不证明利用率必然上升。

title.en: The shared downside is not a site forecast
title.zh: 共用保守压力测试不是场地预测

text.en: The $51,392 revenue versus $60,000 fixed-cost comparison is correct. The error would be using that uncalibrated bundle to rule out real sites. Keep it as a historical stress test and investigate distinct local hypotheses.
text.zh: 51,392美元收入低于60,000美元固定成本的计算正确。若据此排除真实场地，就是误用未经校准的参数组合。保留历史压力测试，同时研究本地假设。

title.en: Four-city paybacks are projections
title.zh: 四座城市的回本期属于预测

text.en: The reported 4–7 year results were media tests of Tesla’s configurator, not measured realized project returns. They are useful vendor comparisons with different growth, rent, cost and horizon assumptions.
text.zh: 所述4–7年是媒体测试Tesla配置器的结果，不是实测的项目回收记录。它们可以参考，但增长、租金、成本及期限假设不同。

title.en: A better energy anchor, with limits
title.zh: 更相关的电量参照及其边界

text.en: The live Tesla tooltip states approximately 35 kWh per session. We use kWh per post per calendar day as the main demand unit; 35 only converts units. Neither that average nor the US network usage claim establishes local paid demand.
text.zh: Tesla当前原始提示框写明每次约35 kWh。模型以每枪每个日历日的电量为需求单位；35只作单位换算。平均会话及美国网络利用率均不证明本地付费需求。

title.en: Demand charges cannot be counted twice
title.zh: 需量费不能重复计算

text.en: The vendor utility field already includes demand and other energy charges at a fleet-based load profile. Higher use may dilute demand charges, but that is not an extra discount on the all-in input; a local interval/tariff model must replace it.
text.zh: 厂家电价字段已按其车队负荷包含需量等费用。增加利用量可能摊薄需量费，但不能在该全包输入上再扣一次；应由当地分时负荷和费率模型替代。

title.en: New-build / four-post staged hypothesis
title.zh: 本地新增 / 四枪分期假设

rationale.en: First investigate a four-post retail site: 24-hour amenities and a larger nearby supply gap than the other urban WinCo options reviewed. This is an investigation priority, not a forecast of market share.
rationale.zh: 优先调查四枪零售站：全天配套，本轮城市WinCo候选中近邻供给间距相对较大。这是调查优先级，不是市场份额预测。

anchors.en: Official store identity/hours were reconfirmed. The retained October 29 supply snapshot has no DCFC record within 3 straight-line miles and a nearest record at 4.1 miles. County traffic records cover the 176th Street corridor, but no exact count/year/location join was verified.
anchors.zh: 重核官方门店身份及营业时间。10月29日供给快照中，直线3英里内没有快充记录，最近记录4.1英里。县交通资料覆盖176街，但未核定精确计数、年份与位置的对应。

counter.en: Home charging can dominate suburban demand. Road traffic, city EV registrations and a database gap do not establish paid charging demand. Utility territory, capacity and parking rights remain unverified.
counter.zh: 郊区可能主要在家充电。道路车流、城市EV注册量及数据库空白均不证明付费需求；供电区域、容量和停车权利待核。

test.en: Match road counters to actual entrances; inspect turning access and nearby South Hill charging queues. Obtain comparable paid energy across seasons, then test incremental capture, complete four-post EPC cost and a written utility service offer.
test.zh: 把交通计数点匹配实际出入口，检查转向通行及South Hill竞品排队。取得跨季节可比付费电量，再核增量捕获、四枪完整EPC费用及书面接电方案。

design.en: Four-post new-build comparison; upgrade savings are not assumed.
design.zh: 四枪全新建设比较；未假定改造可节省成本。

title.en: New-build / neighborhood and commuter retail hypothesis
title.zh: 新增 / 社区与通勤零售假设

rationale.en: First investigate the Bar W retail and commuter catchment. Official amenities and the retained supply gap justify local validation; an overlapping Leander catchment must not be counted twice.
rationale.zh: 优先调查Bar W零售与通勤商圈。官方配套及供给间距支持本地验证；与Leander重叠的商圈不可重复计入。

anchors.en: H-E-B confirms store 774 at 19348 Ronald W. Reagan Blvd, Georgetown 78628, open 06:00–23:00. The city identifies Bar W amenities. Retained inventory places the nearest DCFC about 3.0 miles away, with 16 records within 10 miles.
anchors.zh: H-E-B确认774号门店位于19348 Ronald W. Reagan Blvd、Georgetown 78628，营业06:00–23:00。市政府列明Bar W配套；供给快照最近快充约3.0英里，10英里内16条记录。

counter.en: Tesla normalizes the address to Leander 78641; parcel matching remains unresolved. Store hours do not grant 24/7 charging access. Georgetown city EV totals are not this property’s catchment.
counter.zh: Tesla把地址标准化为Leander 78641，地块匹配尚未解决。门店营业时间不等于全天充电通行权；Georgetown城市EV总量不是该物业商圈。

test.en: Resolve the vendor map point against the official parcel; validate home-charging availability and competing Leander capacity. Obtain host access terms, meter/utility identity, a complete quote and a local demand-transfer case.
test.zh: 把厂家地图点与官方地块对齐，核实家庭充电条件及Leander竞品容量。取得场地主通行条款、电表与供电方身份、完整报价和本地需求迁移依据。

estimate.kind: vendor projection; not measured paid demand

design.en: Four-post new-build comparison; upgrade savings are not assumed.

title.en: Corridor hypothesis — access and demand evidence first
title.zh: 走廊假设——先核通行与需求

rationale.en: Investigate corridor stopping demand after the access screen. Sparse inventory makes the US 290 hypothesis worth testing, but the same Texas vendor default is weaker evidence here than a local traffic/capture study.
rationale.zh: 先核通行，再调查走廊停靠需求。供给稀疏使US 290假设值得验证，但相同的德州厂家默认值弱于当地车流与捕获研究。

anchors.en: Official H-E-B identity confirms 1080 West Hwy 290. Retained inventory has one DCFC record within 10 miles, nearest at 9.5 miles. A September 2026 TxDOT notice identifies a corridor study with potential right-of-way and displacement effects.
anchors.zh: 官方H-E-B确认1080 West Hwy 290。供给快照10英里内仅1条快充记录，最近9.5英里。2026年9月TxDOT公告列明走廊研究及潜在征地、搬迁影响。

counter.en: Through traffic may be commuters charging at home. Elgin’s city EV count is small. Planned road changes can undermine frontage access; no direct impact on this parcel has yet been established.
counter.zh: 过境车流可能是在家充电的通勤者，本地EV规模较小。道路规划可能影响临街通行，但尚未证实该地块的具体影响。

test.en: Overlay current roadway concepts with the parcel and entrances before paying for design. Validate directional EV traffic, stopping need and attainable capture with matched paid analogues; do not multiply all traffic by city EV share.
test.zh: 投入设计前先叠加最新道路方案、地块和出入口。结合付费可比样本核实分方向EV车流、停靠需要和可获得的需求；不可把全部车流直接乘城市EV比例。

title.en: Existing-site expansion / redesign hypothesis
title.zh: 既有场地扩容或重设计假设

rationale.en: Investigate expansion or redesign of an existing charging property. Recovered plans make a scope-matched cost check actionable; this is not a blank-market greenfield recommendation.
rationale.zh: 调查既有充电物业的扩容或重设计。已取得历史图纸，便于核对相同设计范围的成本；不是空白市场新增站推荐。

anchors.en: The official store address and historical BLD2022-0061 charging plans are documented. Existing supply is recorded at the property, with 55 DCFC records within 10 miles.
anchors.zh: 已有官方门店地址及历史BLD2022-0061充电设计。物业已有充电供给记录，10英里内共有55条快充记录。

counter.en: Historical design load is not spare capacity. Existing operator rights and nearby competition may defeat third-party entry. Reuse savings and incremental demand remain unproved.
counter.zh: 历史设计负荷不是剩余容量。既有运营商权利及竞品可能阻止第三方进入；复用节省和增量需求未证实。

test.en: Identify current equipment, operator and host rights; obtain paid throughput and as-built condition. Compare a genuine upgrade quote with a new four-post build, including only assets demonstrably reusable.
test.zh: 查明现有设备、运营商及场地权利，取得付费电量和竣工状态。把真实升级报价与新建四枪比较，只计入确认可复用的资产。

title.en: Prior-project recovery / redesign hypothesis
title.zh: 原项目恢复或重设计假设

rationale.en: Keep as a lower-priority redesign or recovery hypothesis. Existing project records create a useful diligence route, but the new vendor inputs make an unsubsidized full new build less attractive than the other four cases.
rationale.zh: 保留为较低优先级的重设计或恢复假设。历史项目资料提供核查路径，但新厂家参数显示，无补贴全新建设弱于其他四处。

anchors.en: The property is documented and Pacific Power offers eligible nonresidential charging-planning assistance. The earlier ODOT corridor agreement was cancelled; nearby DCFC is recorded at 0.2 miles.
anchors.zh: 物业有资料，Pacific Power向符合条件的非住宅客户提供充电规划支持。此前ODOT走廊协议已取消，最近快充记录仅0.2英里。

counter.en: The reason for cancellation, current rights and reusable work are unknown. Nearby competition weakens incremental demand; the vendor utility proxy is higher than in the WA and TX examples.
counter.zh: 取消原因、现有权利及可复用工程待核；近邻竞争削弱增量需求，厂家电费代理值也高于华盛顿州和德州示例。

test.en: Resolve cancellation and asset rights before a new-build bid. Seek an owner-authorized utility assessment and an explicitly scoped restoration quote; separately verify any rebate and measured incremental demand.
test.zh: 新建投标前先查明取消原因和资产权利。取得业主授权的供电评估和明确范围的恢复报价，单独核实返利及实测增量需求。

estimate.normalizedAddress: 251 E Barnett Rd, Medford, OR 97501, USA
estimate.kind: vendor projection; not measured paid demand

design.en: Four-post new-build comparison; upgrade savings are not assumed.
design.zh: 四枪全新建设比较；未假定改造可节省成本。

conclusion.en: Five hypotheses deserve targeted field checks; none is investment-ready. Puyallup and Ronald Reagan are first investigation priorities; Elgin requires an access screen, while Edmonds and Medford require an existing-project redesign scope. The selected pool is not a national optimum.
conclusion.zh: 五个假设值得定向实地验证，尚无可投资资格。Puyallup与Ronald Reagan优先调查；Elgin先核通行；Edmonds与Medford须先明确既有项目重设计范围。本候选池不是全国最优解。

selection.en: Qualitative diligence order, not a return ranking or probability. Based on retail/access evidence, frozen nearby supply, address certainty and a concrete verification route. Five selected from the existing 37; the other 32 were not proven unviable. No new nationwide inventory sweep.
selection.zh: 定性尽调顺序，不是回报排名或成功概率。依据零售与通行证据、冻结供给、地址确定性及可执行验证路径。从既有37处选5处；未证明其余32处不可行，也未重新普查全国。

excludedNumbers.en: No exact Pierce County traffic count enters sales estimates: the year/location alignment could not be fully verified. The 47,400-road figure is a capacity threshold, not observed demand. The Tesla Q3 original scorecard was inaccessible; rounded secondary global totals are not used.
excludedNumbers.zh: 未把Pierce县精确车流数计入销量：年份与位置对应未完全核实。道路47,400数值属于容量阈值，不是观测需求。Tesla第三季度原始记分卡不可访问，未使用次级报道的四舍五入全球总量。
